title: Marvel Legends Series: Deadpool & Wolverine - Deadpool (Concept Art)
body:
Bring the excitement and wonder of the Marvel Universe to your collection with this Hasbro Marvel Legends Deadpool (Concept Art) action figure!

This collectible 6-inch scale Marvel figure is detailed to look like character design concept art developed for Marvel Studios' Deadpool & Wolverine. Deadpool figure is fully articulated with premium design and poseable head, arms, and legs. Marvel action figure set comes with 11 accessories including 6 alternate hands, 2 katana, knife, and 2 weapon accessories.

Hasbro Marvel action figures' 6 inch scale make them great for displaying in fans' collections. Reimagine movie-inspired scenes on your shelf with Marvel Legends action figures and Marvel collectibles.

Features:

  • MARVEL STUDIOS' DEADPOOL & WOLVERINE: Collectible figure is inspired by Concept Art by the Marvel Studios Visual Development Team created for the movie -- for fans ages 14 and up
  • FILM-INSPIRED ACCESSORIES: Officially licensed Hasbro Marvel Legends set comes with 11 accessories including 6 alternate hands, 2 katana, knife, and 2 weapon accessories
  • PREMIUM DESIGN AND DECO: Fans and collectors can display this premium figure with movie concept art-accurate design and deco in their collection
  • 6-INCH SCALE ACTION FIGURE: Features a window box package and movie branding for display. Figure is designed at the Marvel 6 inch action figure scale (15 cm)
  • DISPLAY-WORTHY ARTICULATION: Collectible action figure features over 20 points of articulation with fully poseable head, arms, and legs
  • BUILD A MULTIVERSE OF MARVEL COLLECTIBLES: Marvel gifts are great for play or display! Add to any collection of Marvel Legends Series figures. (Each sold separately. Subject to availability)

Includes figure and 11 accessories.

  • Figure scale: 6 inches (15 cm)
  • Ages 14 and up
  • WARNING: CHOKING HAZARD – Small parts. Not for children under 3 years.
  • Colors, packaging, accessories, and decorations may vary and are subject to change.

body:
THEY ARE VENOM!

Eddie Brock and Venom are reunited — and it feels so good! After years apart, once again THEY ARE VENOM, and Eddie is not going to let this opportunity go to waste. title: The Amazing Spider-Man: Amazing Visions
body: SPIDER-MAN'S HISTORY — ILLUSTRATED BY LEE BERMEJO! Superstar artist Lee Bermejo captures major moments from Spider-Man's life in 25 stunning variant covers — now collected in one beautiful comic book! Bermejo's covers — which helped count down issue by issue to the landmark AMAZING SPIDER-MAN #1000 — take you from Peter Parker's timeless origin story, in which he learned his painful lesson about power and responsibility, through clashes with classic foes, the devastating loss of Gwen Stacy, the saga of the symbiote costume, his relationship with Mary Jane Watson, the shocking saga of the Superior Spider-Man and more of the events that defined your friendly neighborhood wall-crawler! All presented alongside historical context, insights from the artist, behind-the-scenes artwork, bonus covers and more!

title: Star Trek Space Hunt
body:
Star Trek: Space Hunt is a starship combat game set in the Star Trek universe, using an official license that covers several generations, from classic series to more recent ones. Players take command of famous ships that each play differently, with its own systems and energy limits, and face each other in tense space encounters where positions are hidden and information is incomplete.

Star Trek: Space Hunt is a real-time, team-based hidden-movement game for 2-4 players, inspired by the SONAR system. Players command iconic Star Trek ships in a tense battle of deduction, coordination, and timing.

Players are divided into two opposing crews, ideally played 2 vs 2. Each crew controls one ship and is split into two roles: the Captain, who moves the ship, manages energy, and activates systems, and the Second, who listens to enemy actions and deduces the opposing ship's position. A screen separates teams, keeping ship locations hidden.

The game is played in real time, with both teams acting simultaneously. Ships move across a grid-based space map, announcing each direction of movement. The opposing crew uses this information to track the ship's possible location. Movement generates Energy, which is spent to activate special systems such as Scan, Invisibility, Blackout, Hyperspace Warp, and Torpedoes. Each ship has unique energy costs, creating asymmetric gameplay.

To win, a crew must first destroy at least one enemy base, then destroy the opposing ship. A successful hit ends the game immediately. An optional Academy Mode offers turn-based play for learning and casual games.

Ages: 8+
Players: 2-4
Game Length: 25-40 minutes

title: Marvel Champions: The Card Game - Shadowland Scenario Pack
body:
Shadow has fallen over Hell's Kitchen. A dark force is corrupting the locals, twisting their minds and making them violent. As our heroes arrive to investigate, they find themselves face-to-face with a squad of shadowy villains known as the known as the Dark Protégés. As the corruptive influence sinks its claws deeper into the city, our heroes must navigate the labyrinthian Shadowland if they want any hope of returning things to normal.

This pack includes three brand-new scenarios, each featuring various characters and aspects of the mysterious and deadly organization known as the Hand. Take on members of the Dark Protégés, infiltrate the shifting labyrinth of Shadowland itself, and take on the mastermind behind the corruption of Hell's Kitchen. Each scenario can be played standalone or sequentially in a miniature, three-part campaign. Will you free Hell's Kitchen from the shadowy forces that seek to corrupt it? Or will you fall prey to the allure of dark power yourself?

In this 90-card Scenario Pack:

  • Navigate the twisted labyrinth of Shadowland and stop the Dark Protégés from corrupting Hell's Kitchen!

  • Take on three brand-new scenarios, either standalone or as a three-part campaign.

  • Give in to Shadowland's influence for unique benefits - but take care not to become completely corrupted!

Ages: 14+
Players: 1-4
Game Length: 45-90 minutes

This is not a stand-alone game. A copy of Marvel Champions LCG: Core Set is required to play.

body:
AN ALL-NEW, ALL-DISTURBING UNIVERSE BEGINS HERE!

The clock strikes midnight, and it's the dark dawn of a new era. The shadows of New York City are stalked by vampires and the mutant empyres. title: Flip 7: Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas Edition Game
body: In this press your-luck card game, you are invited to join Jack Skellington and the citizens of Halloweentown as they plan their spine-chilling takeover of Christmas. You score points based on the presents on the cards in front of you. The more presents on a card, the more valuable a card is. Beware, though, there are more copies of that card in the deck! If you ever draw a second card with the same number of presents as one already in your line, you bust and are out of the round, scoring nothing.

title: King of Tokyo: Godzilla
body:
THE TRUE KING OF MONSTERS IS FINALLY HERE!

Toho’s legendary Kaijus clash in an epic battle to decide who will be the definitive King of Tokyo. Play as Godzilla, King Ghidorah, Hedorah, Rodan, Mothra, and Mechagodzilla.

King of Tokyo: Godzilla is a family game with dice, cards, and smashes, inspired by the yams system.

For those familiar with the original game, discover a new mechanic: “Event cards” that affect all monsters. And for fans, yes, evolution cards are included!

Graphics and aesthetics reminiscent of the Showa era of Godzilla (1954-1975)

title: Munchkin: Second Edition
body:
After 25 years of monster-slaying, here it is: a second edition of Munchkin. Players can set up faster and finish faster, with lots of fun in the middle. They'll steal actual (pretend) Gold Coins from the monsters and spend them for levels. And there are new jokes and new monsters, but the old favorites are still here. Who will be the first to 10th Level?

100% illustrated by John Kovalic, with new reference cards for the players, this set also includes guidelines for playing with your favorite OLD Munchkin cards, also available HERE. Or with all of them! You've spent years collecting those cards. Don't throw them out!

title: Spot It: Rudolph (2026 Edition)
body:
Great bouncing icebergs! Get ready for a magical winter wonderland with Rudolph Spot It. Be the first to spot the single match between two cards to win the round. Featuring images of all the characters from the North Pole including Rudolph, Santa Claus, Yukon Cornelius, Bumbles and many more. In this fun card game, there is always only ever one matching symbol between any two cards. Spot it first, and you win! Ages 7 and up. For 2 to 8 players.

The Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer Spot It! Game includes:
55x Cards
1x Rulebook with 5 Mini-games
1x Tin

title: Anomia Pop Culture
body:
Fast paced, brain-bending, and laugh-til-you-cry hilarious, the Anomia Pop Culture Edition features three new decks with over 200 categories drawn from movies, TV, music, the internet, and more! Normally, it's pretty easy to give an example of an action movie, a pop song, or a video game, but you'll find that your brain works a little differently under pressure!

Anomia is simple. Players flip cards until the symbols on two players cards match. Matching players race to give an example of the category on their opponent’s card. Sounds easy, right? Think again. Wild Cards create unexpected matches and even losing a card can set off a chain of cascading face-offs! Look out, it could be your turn at any time!

title: X-Men #38
body: Terrorist, warrior, father, teacher, killer. Magneto has been all of these things. Now he unconsciously assumes a new role: genetic prophet, with a message from the future written in his very blood. But will that message spell deliverance... or doom?

title: Venom #262
body: WHO IS THE NEW ALL-VENOM? Mary Jane Watson is Venom... and so is everybody else! VENOMWORLD LIVES! The war between Knull and Hela just ended — and even Eight Billion Venoms might not be enough to beat the winner! It’s the strangest adventure yet for the World’s Strangest Roommates... but is the lease finally up?

title: The Uncanny X-Men #36
body: WILD RIDE, PART FOUR! The Harbinger of Demons, REPENT, prepares to make the ultimate sacrifice to free an X-Man from what he believes is a homicidal possession. Can the UNCANNY X-MEN survive the experience? It's MUTANT vs. MALICE in a battle for their eternal SOULS! WILD RIDE comes to a stunning conclusion here!

title: Sorcerer Supreme #10
body: THE END OF EXTINCTION? As the EXTINCTION KING unleashes his ultimate weapon, Wanda must put everything on the line to stop him. But magic always has a cost...

title: Fantastic Four #17
body: The Fantastic Four find themselves in a strange environment, with no memory of how they got there... or worse, of who they actually are. There is a rock monster among them. They seem to have strange powers. And each of them has sustained serious injuries, including burns... burns that it’s soon clear only the youngest one could’ve inflicted. The older man — whose limbs have a strange elasticity — has a single word written in blood on his own arm: SURVIVE.

title: Queen in Black #5
body: OH, THE HUMANlTY! In the war between Light and Dark, the winner’s taken their prize... but is it Hela or Knull who’s ascended to the Throne of All? Either way, the only thing standing between them and all life on Earth is... the VENOMWORLD! It’s the ultimate symbiote battle — and for Mary Jane Watson, it’s the last stand!

title: Queen in Black: Venom Unchained #3
body: THE KING IS BACK? Eddie Brock was the King in Black... right up until he wasn’t. It was him vacating the throne that led to the return of Knull and Hela’s rise as the Queen in Black. Can he make up for his mistake? Could he take back the crown as god of symbiotes?

title: Godzilla [2016] The Second Form & Third Form & Giant Unidentified Creature Set
body:
The Giant Unidentified Creature that appeared at the beginning of the film is brought to life for the first time faithfully recreating the image of the tail protruding from the sea surface.

Godzilla (2016) Second Form and Godzilla (2016) Third Form use previously well-received models. This action figure set is colored based on video footage of the Giant Unidentified Creature as seen in the film, with the ocean surface parts colored red to recreate the reddened sea upon its appearance.

Each segment of the tail is articulated, allowing for smooth movements as in the film. Godzilla (2016) Second Form and Godzilla (2016) Third Form have articulated parts to recreate characteristic poses for each form.

Bring the chaos and charm of Gotham's most unpredictable villain home with this exclusive Funko Pop! Animation figure of Harley Quinn from Batman: The Animated Series. Perfect for collectors of DC animation memorabilia and fans of the beloved animated series. Display her alongside other Batman universe characters to complete your collection. A must-have for enthusiasts of classic animation and Funko Pop! vinyl figures.

title: Gundam MG 1/100 The Gundam Base Limited RX-78-2 Gundam Ver.3.0 [The Gundam Base Color] Model Kit
body:
For GUNPLA fans around the world, this is a limited edition GUNPLA at the official GUNPLA complex "GUNDAM Base". The RX-78-2 GUNDAM with Master Grade Ver. 3.0 is now available in a refreshing blue GUNDAM base color.
■ Equipped with a "movable armor system" that adopts a new movable interpretation. Mobility linked to the inside of the armor parts is added.
■ Shoulder armor and backpack covers can also be moved, improving the freedom of arm movement.
■ The opening and closing mechanism of the shin back armor also improves the range of motion of the ankle.
■ The core fighter can be transformed and stored inside the body.
■ Paintable material is used for the internal structure.
■ Shoulder armor, shields, etc., GUNDAM Base original special marking stickers are included.

title: The Sundering (PB)
body:
When treachery strikes, the elven kingdom of Ulthuan is plunged into a bitter civil war that will change the destiny of the elf race – and the entire world – forever.

READ IT BECAUSE
The full story of the war that divided a race and changed the Old World forever... through the eyes of those at the heart of the conflict. Gav Thorpe's classic trilogy returns, along with an additional novella and short story, including the first ever look through the eyes of the Witch King, Malerion, before he turned evil.

THE STORY
Malerion, betrayer and usurper, architect of the great war that will forever divide the race of elves. Alith Anar, wrathful avenger whose spirit will forever haunt the traitorous druchii. Caledor, reluctant leader, the one elf who can hold back the darkness and restore peace to Ulthuan. Witch King, Shadow King, and Phoenix King. Their deeds are legend. This is their story.

CONTENTS
– Malerion (novel)
– Shadow King (novel)
– Caledor (novel)
– The Bloody-Handed (novella)
– The Dark Path (short story)

Written by Gav Thorpe.

title: Dawn of Fire: Crusade of Vengeance (PB)
body:
As the Indomitus Crusade spreads out across the galaxy, one battlefleet must face a dread Slaughter Host of Chaos. Their success or failure may define the very future of the crusade – and the Imperium.

READ IT BECAUSE

Experience the first three novels of the Dawn of Fire series, following the Indomitus Crusade and its desperate fight for the future of the Imperium. Assailed by Chaos, Orks, and re-emerging ancient xenos threats – will Guilliman's gambit pay off?

THE STORY
A great darkness has befallen the galaxy, and the armies of Chaos are rampant. To survive, humanity must retaliate and take back what they have lost. By the will of the reborn primarch, Roboute Guilliman, is the Indomitus Crusade launched – a military undertaking that eclipses all others in known history. From the Throneworld of Terra does the Avenging Son hurl his fleets, their mission the very salvation of mankind.

CONTENTS
– Avenging Son (Novel) by Guy Haley
– The Gate of Bones (Novel) by Andy Clark
– The Wolftime (Novel) by Gav Thorpe

title: Master of Rites (PB)
body:
Ferren Areios, Captain of the Ultramarines Sixth Company, seeks to cleanse the worlds of the Reach from the clutches of the Death Guard – a task that will push him to the limits of his Chapter's creed.

READ IT BECAUSE
We first met Ferren Areios in the epic Dawn of Fire series. He has since ascended to the rank of Captain of the Ultramarines Sixth Company, earning the title Master of Rites. Now he must face his most challenging task to date – taking on the Death Guard in a grinding war where little glory can be found. Honour demands that this task must be undertaken, and who better to lead it than the Master of Rites?

THE STORY
The Khorsari Reach has been lost to the Imperium for over a decade, locked behind the warp storms that cling to the edges of the Great Rift. Its worlds have been claimed by the Death Guard, its people slaughtered by the servants of the Plague God. But these are the worlds of Ultramar, and they are protected.

Ferren Areios, Captain of the Ultramarines Sixth Company, has been dispatched to retake the worlds of the Reach and cleanse them of the Death Guard’s corruption. But as the Plague Marines dig in and the death toll rises to catastrophic heights, Ferren is pushed to the limits of his Chapter’s creed. Isolated in the Plague God’s domain, the reclamation fleet fights not only for the worlds of the Reach, but for what remains of Ferren’s own humanity.

Written by Rob Young.

title: Helbrecht: Sin of Hope (HB)
body:
Helbrecht sees a future of the Imperium renewed and free of the Ruinous Powers. Yet when he must form an unpalatable alliance with the Leagues of Votann, he questions if it is worth the sacrifice to heal what damage has been done to the Imperium.

READ IT BECAUSE
Experience what happens when High Marshal Helbrecht of the Black Templars fights to find his place in a changed order. Just how far is this zealous yet pragmatic warrior willing to go?

THE STORY
Driven by duty and faith, Helbrecht glimpses what might yet be: an Imperium wholly renewed. But the risk is great, for in order to seize such a prize he must rally his Chapter and the Elysian troops of the Astra Militarum against the unholy terrors of the Ruinous Powers.

When fate – or providence – grants the High Marshal a distasteful ally in the Leagues of Votann, he must ask himself what he is willing to forsake in the pursuit of triumph. Helbrecht knows the meaning of sacrifice well, but rekindling this ancient glory may push him to the very brink.

Written by Mike Vincent.

title: Space Marines Codex (2026 Edition)
body:
Inside this 232-page softcover book, you'll find:

– A collecting section containing advice on building a thematic army and working towards detachments, with painting guides and tips for creating a themed battlefield

– Foldout front and back covers, featuring epic photography and a progress report on the restoration of the Ultramarines' fortress monastery

Inside the back cover, you’ll find a unique code that will unlock the Space Marines faction in Warhammer 40,000: The App, including ongoing access to more free Space Marines content over time.

title: Space Marines: Captain on Bike (2026 Edition)
body:
The Captain can be assembled with a master-crafted power weapon, a hard-hitting thunder hammer, or a plasma pistol in their right hand. The base can be assembled with or without a decorative rock, with a leg either planted on the ground or on the bike's foot peg, in which case the bike can also be assembled tilting to the left or the right. You'll find a mounted sword sheath that can be assembled with or without the sword, and a mounted holster with or without a pistol. There are also two helmeted heads and three bare head options to choose from.

Contents:
– 42 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 90mm by 52.5mm Oval Base
– 1 construction guide

title: Space Marines: Outrider Squad (2026 Edition)
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds 3 Outriders for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. These highly mobile warriors allow you to control the flow of battle with their wide threat range, and strike at vulnerable enemy flanks before they have a chance to react. Armed with heavy bolt pistols and chainswords, as well as the twin bolt rifles mounted to their bikes, they are as deadly at range as they are in melee. You'll find Outrider Squads a powerful and flexible unit that deserves a place in any strike force.

Customise your Wargear

Each bike can be assembled upright, or tilting left or right. One miniature can be assembled as either a standard Outrider or Outrider Sergeant with a tilting shield and unique helmet. The Sergeant can replace his chainsword with a thunder hammer, power sword, or power axe. One Outrider can replace their heavy bolt pistol with a plasma pistol. This versatile kit also includes many interchangeable parts, allowing you to mix up your miniatures so no two units need look alike.

Interchangeable parts:
– 7 bare heads
– 3 helmeted heads
– 3 left shoulder pads
– 4 right shoulder pads
– 3 backpacks
– 2 left arms holding handlebars
– 3 right arms holding handlebars
– 6 left arms
– 4 left hands with chainsword
– 1 right arm with plasma pistol
– 2 right arms with heavy bolt pistol
– 2 swords in sheaths
– 3 empty sword sheaths
– 3 pistols in holsters
– 2 empty pistol holsters
– 6 optional pouches, grenades, and accessories

Contents:
– 128 plastic components
– 3 Citadel 90mm by 52.5mm Oval Bases
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Space Marines Infantry Transfer Sheet

The Space Marines Infantry Transfer Sheet features 664 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols and icons for the Ultramarines, Imperial Fists, Salamanders, and Raptors, as well as unit designations, numbers, honour markings, and campaign badges to decorate your miniatures.

title: Reality Fracture - Sleeved Play Booster Pack
body:
Play Boosters are the ideal choice for exploring the set and playing Limited Format events. Whether players are drafting with friends, chasing Booster Fun, or simply expanding their collections, Play Boosters offer something for everyone. Every booster pack includes a legendary card as well as its Echoverse alternate, setting the stage for a clash of epic proportions!
More about Reality Fracture
Mastermind mage Jace Beleren has pushed reality to its breaking point. An alternate Multiverse of his own creation threatens to overtake the current one, and just one brave team of heroes stands in the path of oblivion. Be on the lookout for twisted new reflections of Magic' legends as you explore Jace's Echoverse and his inner sanctum within the dystopian school of Hexhaven.

• 14 Magic: The Gathering cards

body:
Oh, bother! Piglet’s been pignapped by some prickly tendrils. With a few good friends by the players’ side, they’ll navigate a “mulchtitude” of perils to rescue him. But the mission doesn’t end there. Illumineers must delve further into the roots and uncover the heart of this thorny problem.

As players trek through overgrown passages and tunnels, the must keep an eye out. A leafy monstrosity could ambush them at any moment, or a special attack might hedge any progress.
Whether Illumineers undertake this journey solo or together with a friend, the two prebuilt player decks are crafted to harvest the confidence and courage needed for such a daring expedition.

title: Transformers Age of the Primes - The Thirteen Liege Maximo Figure
body:
This premium collectible action figure depicts the fearsome and cunning Liege Maximo, one of the legendary original Thirteen Primes from the Transformers fictional universe. This exceptional model forms part of the brand-new Age of the Primes technology range developed by manufacturer Hasbro.
The model incorporates the stylistic features and high-quality finish of the Transformers Generations range, combining cutting-edge engineering with complex articulation. This exclusive 2-in-1 figure features a smooth 25-step conversion system, allowing it to switch from an imposing 21.5 cm tall robot mode to a Cybertronian alien spaceship-style vehicle mode. The figure faithfully captures the regal, dark and horned appearance of this legendary manipulator, with meticulous attention to its mechanical detailing and contrasting colours. For maximum playability and customisation, the robot comes with a full arsenal including a laser blaster and 3 Liege darts. Furthermore, its head horns can be cleverly detached to serve as additional hand weapons.
Designed primarily for display on a shelf, desk or in a collector’s display case, this articulated figure allows you to recreate numerous dynamic combat poses. It comes in its original sealed cardboard packaging with stylish graphics, protecting the entire robot and its accessories.

The 200-card base set features NFL rookies and veterans, complemented by a 201-card Bowman Prospect set showcasing top collegiate talent. Autographs from prospects, rookies, and veterans add depth across the checklist.

Bowman favorites return with Spotlights, Crystallized, and Etched-In Glass, while Anime and GPK inserts bring bold new energy to the product.

The Bowman Red Rookie Redemption also makes its football debut, featuring special short-print Red RCs eligible for FanCash rewards tied to career milestones, beginning with NFL Rookie of the Year honors.

title: Brawlers of Behemat - Sons of Behemat
body:
This box set contains 2 multipart plastic Mega-Gargants and 2 ruins of Embergard terrain pieces with barricades, along with the rules and gaming accessories you need to play the Brawlers of Behemat game.

This set contains:
– 1 softback 24-page Brawlers of Behemat Rulebook
– 3 Mega-Gargant dashboards, 1 for each type of Mega-Gargant
– 1 token sheet containing 42 tokens
– 2 Mega-Gargant miniatures
– 2 Embergard terrain pieces

Both Mega-Gargants in this boxed set may be built as a Warstomper, a Kraken-eater, or a Gatebreaker, meaning you can build 2 of the same, or assemble 2 different Mega-Gargants to battle it out. They both come with 3 cosmetic accessories which you can use to customise them.

The Embergard terrain includes interchangeable wall pieces, allowing a degree of customisation.

This kit is supplied with:
– 289 plastic components
– 2 Citadel 130mm Round Bases

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted.

title: Stomper Tribe -Sons of Behemat
body:
This boxed set builds 4 multipart plastic Sons of Behemat miniatures:
– 1 Warstomper Mega-Gargant (can alternatively be built as a Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant or Kraken-eater Mega-Gargant)
– 3 Mancrusher Gargants

The Warstomper Mega-Gargant comes with 3 optional decorative components you can add to customise your miniature.

The Mancrusher Gargants are highly customisable, with a variety of build options:
– 2 left arms
– 2 right arms
– 3 pairs of feet
– 5 left hands
– 4 right hands holding different weapons
– 4 heads
– 2 loincloths
– 1 optional spiked collar
– 2 optional base decorations
– 16 additional decorations, including a man-sized cage with an optional prisoner to go inside

Contents:
– 354 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 130mm Round Base
– 3 Citadel 90mm by 52mm Oval Bases
– 1 construction guide

title: Boss-stompers - Sons of Bhemat
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds 3 Boss-stompers, egotistical melee fighters for your Sons of Behemat armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. These hulking bruisers are perfect for shattering enemy lines with savage blows from their clubs, or headbutting foes out of existence. The kit includes components to build an optional Champion, and 6 interchangeable club head options to customise your miniatures.

This unit can alternatively be built as Rock-hurlers, stone-chucking ranged specialists.

Contents:
– 70 plastic components
– 3 Citadel 90mm Round Bases
– 1 construction guide

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted.

title: Destruction Battletome: Sons of Behemat
body:
This 88-page hardback book contains:
– Background, art, and fiction exploring the hulking Sons of Behemat
– A description of each of their units, along with detailed photography and artwork
– Faction rules including battle traits, battle formations, heroic traits, artefacts of power, Realm-shaking Rampages, Spells, and Prayers
– 11 warscrolls, covering every unit
– A Spearhead guide, including gameplay and hobby advice, along with its own set of warscrolls and army abilities for the Stone Lobbas
– Narrative Path to Glory rules, including the Anvil of Apotheosis, allowing you to create your own hero
– Rules for 2 thematic Armies of Renown, and 5 Regiments of Renown that can be added to other Destruction armies
– A handy reference section with army abilities, magic, and battle traits
– An 8-page gatefold section featuring background on Gargantkind in Ghur, a detailed map of the Everspring Swathe, notable locations to the Sons of Behemat, and more

title: Warscroll Cards: Sons of Behemat (2026 refresh)
body:
This set of 17 cards will help you keep track of your Sons of Behemat in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. There are individual warscroll cards for each unit – detailing their profiles, wargear, options, and special abilities. They are an ideal way to check key information in the heat of battle. You'll also find special warscroll cards for use in Spearhead games. These cards are only available while stocks last.

Contains 17 Cards:
– 11 warscroll cards
– 6 Spearhead cards with battle traits, regiment abilities, and enhancements for the Stone Lobbas and Wallsmasher Stomp Spearheads

All cards measure 70mm by 121mm. Some are double-sided, featuring colour-coded rules and abilities on one side, with an explanation of each on the reverse.

title: Ma Maegran – Chooser of the Mighty - Sons of Behemat
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds Ma Maegran – Chooser of the Mighty, accompanied by 2 Ancient Ghyrochs, for your Sons of Behemat armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. The Chooser of the Mighty hacks foes down with the intimidating Spear of Krum Kalda and shepherds a pair of immense beasts known as Ancient Ghyrochs into battle. The life magic of Ghyran resonating within these beasts’ squat bodies makes them difficult to slay, and supplements the Chooser of the Mighty’s already significant power. Ma Maegran has memorised many weird, witchy cantrips and curses, which she uses to goad nearby gargant units into terrified action and further rampages.

Contents:
– 57 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 90mm Round Base
– 2 Citadel 105mm by 70mm Oval Bases
– 1 construction guide

title: Hololive TCG hEB01: Extra Booster: Summer hologram Booster Pack
body:
An Extra Booster, “Summer hologram,” is coming to the hololive OFFICIAL CARD GAME!
What Is an Extra Booster?
Extra Boosters are special pack products built around unique themes for each release.
The theme this time is: “That summer spent with your Oshi.”
Most of the new and reprinted cards feature summer-themed illustrations! Whether you’ve recently started playing hololive OCG or have been enjoying the game for a long time, this is a product we highly recommend!
About the Reprinted Cards
Selected cards from previously released products, including SorAZ Celebration, are being reprinted!
That card you’ve been hoping for might finally make a return…!?
About the New Cards
Tokino Sora, Houshou Marine, and Hakui Koyori receive brand-new Oshi holomem and holomem cards in new colors!
Of course, brand-new support cards are also included!
By combining them with the reprinted cards, you can build entirely new decks using this product alone!

Overview:
• Of the 102 total card types, 68 are reprinted cards.
• The 68 reprinted cards are selected from cards included up through the Booster Pack Enchant Regalia (released in April 2026).
• This product includes 112 types of parallel cards.
Normal Cards:Total 102 types
• OSR:3 types
• RR:15 types
• R:22 types
• U:37 types
• C:25 types
  • Rarity:None
  • Product Configuration:10 cards per pack.

title: Francisco Lindor 2015 Topps Heritage Rookie High Number Chrome Purple Refractor #717– SGC 9
body:
Offered is a 2015 Topps Heritage High Number Chrome Purple Refractor Rookie Card of Francisco Lindor, card #717, graded SGC 9 Mint.

This card comes from the highly collectible 2015 Topps Heritage High Number release and features Lindor's recognized rookie-year issue. The Chrome Purple Refractor parallel is significantly tougher than the standard Heritage Chrome version and remains a favorite among Lindor collectors due to its scarcity and eye appeal.

Francisco Lindor has established himself as one of the premier shortstops of his generation, earning multiple All-Star selections, Gold Gloves, Silver Sluggers, and long-term hobby relevance. Rookie refractors from flagship-style Topps products continue to attract strong collector demand.

The card is professionally graded SGC 9 Mint, offering strong presentation and protection while maintaining affordability compared with Gem Mint examples.

Card Details:

  • Set: 2015 Topps Heritage High Number Baseball
  • Player: Francisco Lindor
  • Card Number: #717
  • Parallel: Chrome Purple Refractor
  • Designation: Rookie Card (RC)
  • Grade: SGC 9 Mint
  • Manufacturer: Topps

Key Features:

  • Francisco Lindor rookie card
  • Chrome Purple Refractor parallel
  • SGC 9 Mint grade
  • Popular Heritage High Number release
  • Strong appeal for rookie, Mets, and Lindor collectors

A desirable Lindor rookie refractor that blends the classic Heritage design with Chrome technology and one of the hobby's most consistent star shortstops.

title: Topps Flagship Premier League 2026/27 - Value Box
body:
Built around one of the most iconic hobby brands, Topps Flagship Premier League 2026/27 combines a comprehensive base set, exciting new inserts with a deep autograph lineup featuring the league's biggest stars, rising talents, and legendary names. Whether you're building your club's set, chasing rare parallels, or hunting the next great rookie card, this collection delivers a collecting experience that reflects the excitement and drama of the world's most watched football league.

The chase begins with the expansive Base Set, featuring all the biggest stars and emerging talents of the Premier League. Common inserts include Beast Mode, Nitro Boost, Flying the Flag, and Stars of the Premier League, celebrating the league's biggest personalities and most exciting players. Uncommon inserts such as Retro Threads, 8 Bit Ballers, and Remember the Name bring fresh designs and unique storytelling to the product.Collectors can elevate their collection with premium Chrome Classics cards and the Gold Lion subset.

For collectors chasing true rarity, Topps Flagship Premier League 2026/27 features standout short prints including All Kings, ULTRA Beast Mode, and Diamond Rookies.

The autoagraph lineup delivers one of the deepest autograph offerings ever assembled in a Premier League release. Featuring Base Card Autographs, Future Stars Autographs, Stars of the Premier League Autographs, Dual Autographs, Chrome Classics Autographs, Black Edge Autograph Parallel, Marks of Excellence plus more. Look out for 25 Years Champions Anniversary On-Card Autographs and Golden Boot On-Card Autographs, featuring some of the most iconic names to ever play in the Premier League.

Relic collectors can pursue Base Card Relics, Topps Autograph Relics, and Topps 'Premier Class' Autograph Relics, combining authentic memorabilia with signatures from some of the game's most celebrated players.
10 Cards Per Pack. 6 Packs Per Box.

title: Machi Koro Life
body:
You’ve built the perfect town. Now it’s time to build the perfect life! Chase big dreams, invest in hobbies, throw parties, change careers, and see where your choices take you. Every card you add shapes the story of your life as you try to create something truly fulfilling.

On your turn, roll one or two dice to see which of your cards earn you hearts. Hearts are your money, and you’ll use them to buy new Life cards that generate income and Dream cards that bring you closer to winning. Some cards help you. Some cards affect everyone at the table. The first player to collect 8 VIP points from Dream cards wins and proves they’ve built the most successful life.

title: DND ICONS OF THE REALMS: Drow Warband
body:
This set contains:

  • Drow of Lolth (25mm base): Zealous followers of the Spider Queen Lolth, these Drow now consider the Underdark to be their true home, often raiding the surface in preparation for an ultimate war. 
  • Drow Assassin (25mm base): Uniquely trained in the usage of poison, these Drow are remorseless murderers, taking lives at the behest of any who can afford their services. 
  • Drow Mage of Lolth (25mm base): Summoning Fiends straight from the Abyss, these Drow have pursued the path of arcane study to prove their devotion to Lolth. 
  • Drow Priestess of Lolth (25mm base): Dangerous spellcasters, these Drow have risen through the matriarchal ranks of their kin to become priestesses in service to the Spider Queen. 
  • Drow Shadowblade (25mm base): Ruthless killers harnessing the fiendish powers of shadow magic, Drow shadowblades find employment with the noble houses of the Underdark, protecting their enclaves from enemies and eliminating any rivals that would threaten them. 
  • Drow Matron Mother (25mm base): High-ranking priestesses of Lolth, the matron mothers sit at the head of each of the Drow’s noble houses, commanding great power and wielding it with mercilessness; all to make their scheming god proud.

title: GLUTOS ORSCOLLION LORD OF GLUTTONY
body:
Indulge in the decadent excesses of Chaos with Glutos Orscollion, Lord of Gluttony, the opulent and commanding centerpiece of any Hedonites of Slaanesh army. Part living idol, part battlefield overlord, Glutos rides into war atop an extravagant palanquin borne by loyal attendants, his every need catered to even as carnage unfolds around him.

This lavish multi-figure kit features incredible detail, from Glutos’ corpulent form and ornate finery to the finely sculpted attendants preparing delicacies, pouring drinks, and offering whispered counsel. The palanquin itself is a masterpiece of baroque Slaaneshi design—decorated with swirling motifs, elegant weaponry, and symbols of unrestrained indulgence.

On the tabletop, Glutos is a powerful support and combat hero, enhancing nearby allies while wielding formidable personal abilities. His presence can shift the flow of battle, granting his Hedonites newfound resilience, sorcerous strength, and overwhelming force.

Perfect for painters, collectors, and players seeking a showstopping centerpiece, Glutos Orscollion embodies everything the Dark Prince promises: decadence, excess, and irresistible power.

title: White Dwarf 528 (OOS)
body:
The Red Skull Kommandos
Orks are just simple-minded brutes, right? Wrong! We take a look at Snikrot’s boyz. From a safe distance, of course. Like, 100 miles away.

Rules of Engagement
The first of our new-look tactics articles focusing on the detachment system and how it can benefit your army on the tabletop.

The Caedomian Crusade
Witches and heretics beware, because this gorgeous collection of Black Templars is merciless in its magnificence (and vice-versa).

Titanic Duel
Orks! Orks! Orks! We provide rules for the Gorkanaut (and Morkanaut) in our Titanic Duel mini-game.

WARHAMMER AGE OF SIGMAR

Designers’ Notes: The Hungry Hordes
Meat! Entrails! Lots of hungry mouths! We take a deep dive into the design of the new Ogor Mawtribes range of miniatures.

Paint Splatter: Ogor Mawtribes
Paint Splatter? More like food splatter. We serve up a five-course painting guide for Ogors, plus an extra wintery scheme. Brrrrrr.

Battle Report: The Meat Tithe
Meaty Ogors take on bony skeletons in a royal rumble of epic proportions. Or maybe that rumbling is their stomachs…

Cogforts of the Realms
They ain't just castles on legs, you know. More background and new rules for customising our favourite new war machines.

More-more Cogforts
One of the studio’s Warlock Engineers got his hands on a Cogfort and did something unsqueakable to it. All power to the Warpfort!

OTHER ARTICLES

Imperial Might
Are they really small or just really far away? Oh, they're really small… but they're also beautifully painted. Imperial Fists, Legions Imperialis-style.

Voyage of the Saltfyre: Leviadons of the Ravaged Coast
Snerrek and Bluetongue return for more nautical misadventures in the second part of our Skaven short story. More-more boat-boat.

Access Granted
Here you will find painting challenges and the latest Bunker news. Enter at your peril.

Your Warhammer
We feature your elite units, a huge Titan, some lovely letters, and a question about Von Ryan.

The White Dwarf Round-up
Our whimsical musings on the month that’s just gone, including a tiny Tech-Priest and a question about slimy bases.

Bunker Bingo
A couple of models painted by members of the White Dwarf team, plus you get to see our ugly mugs/beautiful faces [delete as appropriate].

Each copy of White Dwarf 528 also comes with:
– 1 A4 tear-out card featuring the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar Scenarios of the Month
– 2 A4 tear-out cards featuring 12 double-sided punch-out 60mm by 90mm Warhammer 40,000 11th Edition core Stratagem reference cards, and a 100mm by 150mm Victory Points tracker

Pokémon ex Bring Color to Your Day and Leap with Stealth into the Night!
Whether it’s day or night, it’s always a great time to celebrate 30 years of Pokémon! Sylveon ex or Greninja ex can add a special touch to your battles as a foil promo card in both ready-to-play and dazzling oversize versions. You also get four booster packs from the special 30th Celebration expansion to keep the fun going.

title: 30th Celebration Knock Out Collection
body:
Thirty years of Pokémon, One Awesome Set!
Celebrate 30 years of Pokémon and discover a treasure trove of Pokémon TCG fun in this special set featuring the Evolution Pokémon Eevee as a cool foil card! You'll also find two Pokémon TCG booster packs to open, plus a plastic coin.

Each Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration Knock Out Collection contains:
• 1 foil promo card featuring Eevee
• 1 plastic coin
• 2 Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration booster packs (cards vary by pack)

title: 30th Celebration Poster Collection
body:
Unfold the Fun of 30 Years of Pokémon!
Get in on the excitement of 30 years of Pokémon with a poster featuring images of over 160 cards from the special 30th Celebration expansion! You also get foil promo cards featuring three powerful Legendary Pokémon from the Kanto region—Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres—plus a handful of booster packs with even more Pokémon inside.

Each Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration Poster Collection contains:
• 3 foil promo card featuring Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres
• 1 double-sided poster 26.875" x 39"
• 3 Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration booster packs (cards vary by pack)

title: NERF K-Pop Demon Hunters - Zoey's Spirit Blades
body:
This lightweight foam replica depicts the famous Zoey’s Spirit Blade, the mystical and razor-sharp weapon from the Netflix animated film and fantasy musical *K-Pop Demon Hunters*, developed by the Nerf brand and manufacturer Hasbro.
True to the dynamic and colourful style of the original work, this role-play accessory designed by Nerf, measuring approximately 20 cm in length, stands out for its manoeuvrability and optimal safety. It carefully showcases the urban pop aesthetic of the combat gear used by the group’s rapper, featuring a streamlined design made from high-density soft foam. Thanks to its ergonomic handle, which ensures a secure grip and perfect stability during rapid movements, this dagger is ideal for embarking on epic adventures and fictional battles in the living room.
Perfect for role-play, this collectable item is ideal for fans’ cosplay or to complete a collection of ritual weapons alongside Rumi’s and Mira’s sabres.

title: HG MS-06S CHAR'S ZAKU II THE ORIGIN 1/144 Model Kit
body:
Great high grade gunpla of Char Aznable's MS-06S Zaku II (standard 2015 edition) from Mobile Suit Gundam - The Origin OVAs.

This is a snap-fit 1:144 model kit requiring assembly.

It features an anti-ship rifle, 2x Heat Hawks (one to be carried at its side and one combat ready), a bazooka, the shoulder shield with bazooka spare ammos, stickers and a movable "monoeye" gimmick.

It comes with alternative chest and head parts to build a normal MS-06 Zaku II instead of Char's.

It's recommended to use hobby nippers to properly detach the components from the runners.

All parts snap together without gluing, making the building process easier and faster than that of more "conventional" models, even for beginners.

You can paint it using proper colors and your favorite techniques (Gundam Markers, brush, airbrush and/or spray cans), but it's not mandatory, since all pieces come already molded in color.

The Action Base display stand is sold separately.

title: #3 Sugai's Gelgoog (GQ) Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX, Bandai Hobby HG 1/144 Model Kit
body:
HG 1/144 Sugai's Gelgoog (GQ) is from the new anime series Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX, featuring the custom unit piloted by Shiiko Sugai. This kit offers a detailed and articulated representation of the mobile suit, complete with unique features and accessories.

 

Key Features

  • Authentic Color Scheme: The model replicates Sugai's Gelgoog in its on-screen colors, capturing its distinctive appearance from the series.
  • Flexible Weaponry: Both the beam rifle and beam saber can be equipped in either hand, allowing for versatile posing options.
  • MovableRear Thrusters: The rear thrusters are designed to be flexibly movable, enhancing the range of dynamic poses.
  • Lead Wire for Grappling Hook: A lead wire is included to represent the mobile suit's grappling hook mechanism, a signature feature of Sugai's unit.
  • Unique Saber Mounting: The beam saber can be attached to both the upper and lower sides of the mobile suit, thanks to an original HG gimmick.

Included Accessories

  • Weapon set (beam rifle and beam saber)
  • Hand parts set
  • Marking stickers
  • Lead wire

Features of BANDAI SPIRITS MODEL KITS
1. NO GLUE
All of the parts can be easily put together without any glue.

2. EASY COLOR RECREATION
The one and only technology that enables four colors to be available in one set of parts, which we call it “runner”

3. RELIABLE HIGH QUALITY
We strive to use our experience and technology to deliver high-quality products to our users around the world.

 

The product box will have a Bandai Namco warning label, which is proof that you are purchasing an officially licensed product.

title: Harmonies Pulse
body:
With the Pulse expansion for Harmonies, your landscape becomes more dynamic. It introduces additional animal cards with a variety of requirements, which will test your spatial organization. The familiar mechanics are still present, but the decisions become much more demanding. At the heart of the expansion are new three-color patterns, requiring more planning and anticipation in placement. Players who take on these new challenges will have additional scoring opportunities — but they need to think even more carefully about how to integrate each element into their landscape. The beautifully illustrated Animal cards fit seamlessly into the base game while providing a new tactical boost.

  • ADVANCED STRATEGY EXPANSION: Adds deeper decision-making and complexity to Harmonies with new gameplay challenges and tactical choices.
  • NEW THREE-COLOR PATTERNS: Introduces advanced placement mechanics that require careful planning, spatial reasoning, and forward thinking.
  • ADDITIONAL ANIMAL CARDS: Expands gameplay with beautifully illustrated animal cards featuring varied requirements and new scoring opportunities.
  • ENHANCED REPLAYABILITY: Fresh combinations and increased difficulty create a more dynamic and engaging experience for returning players.
  • SEAMLESS BASE GAME INTEGRATION: Designed to work smoothly with Harmonies, preserving core mechanics while elevating strategic depth.

Contents:

10x new Animal cards per flowpack, 6x flowpacks per display, 1 Reminder card, 1 Multi-lingual rulebook

title: Beadle and Grimm's Star Trek Strange New Worlds - Mary Celeste Escape Room Game
body:
Have you ever wanted to be a Starfleet cadet leading an away mission to an unknown alien ship? 

Now’s your chance.

You are a cadet aboard the Enterprise on what you thought was a routine training mission. Coming out of warp, the Enterprise has discovered a strange, and apparently abandoned, alien ship. You are summoned to the briefing room to discover that Captain Pike and First Officer Spock have given you your first assignment! Your mission is to discover who built the mysterious spaceship, now codenamed Mary Celeste, and what happened to them. If successful, you will have a chance not just to unravel the mystery, but to save the crew from their fate.

Use all your wits, training, and your augmented reality digital assistant, to bring the Mary Celeste back to life, find the crew, and help them escape an ancient enemy. 

This game is full of lore and easter eggs for serious Star Trek fans, but is mostly for anyone who enjoys a mystery to unravel.

title: Row Your Goat
body:
Move fast, make matches, and get ready to scream!

Row Your Goat is a rapid-fire picture-matching, fast slapping game. Get rid of your cards by placing them in a grid. The second you see a matching set of 3 in a row, slap the nearest Lifesaver. Hurry, there's only a few of them. And if you don't grab one fast enough, you're left collecting cards. When you're down to one card, scream “ROW MY GOAT”, play your card, and slap a Lifesaver to win.

It's fast, frantic, and fantastic as a party game, kid game, or a showstopper for family game night.

title: Horrible Therapist
body:
Therapy can be horrible so we made a game about it.

Playing is easy. You’ll make 3 panel comics about it with your friends. You’ll laugh. You’ll gasp. You’ll be mildly offended (in a fun way). But ultimately, you’ll feel great when your intrusive thoughts help you win this adult card game! 

Perfect for pregaming, parties, or any situation where you need to get rowdy with a group.

title: Giants Moving Tiny Furniture
body:
Meet Giants Moving Tiny Furniture, the highly competitive, highly clumsy party game.

Your team's goal is to move miniature furniture to its new home in as few trips as you can, as quickly as possible. The catch is, you can only use your pinkies! You gotta stack the goods, plan your trip, and work together to make sure you don't drop anything. The team that completes the most successful moving jobs wins.

It's a family game about teamwork, nail-biting moments, hilarity, dexterity, and really cute miniature toy furniture.

title: Poetry for Neanderthals
body:
U MUST SPEAK IN SINGLE SYLLABLES OR GET HIT WITH STICK.

Poetry for Neanderthals is a family-friendly party game where players earn points by getting their teammates to guess words and phrases. The catch is that they can only use single syllable words to give clues. If they use any words with more than one syllable, the other team gets to bop them with a 2-foot inflatable club.

title: Am I the Ass? the Game
body:
Step into the world of Am I the ASS?, the provocative party game that dives into real-life dilemmas and public judgment! Designed for 2-5 players, this game features 150 authentic and often awkward scenarios, each drawn from real situations that challenge you to determine: Was this person really an ass, or did they just find themselves in a tough spot?

The twist? You're not just giving your opinion; you're predicting how 500 people from around the world reacted! Armed with your Ass-o-Meter, you'll gauge the public's sentiment on each scenario. Scenarios include dating/relationships, family dynamics, workplace conflicts, money, parenting, roommates, social etiquette, and downright bad behavior. After the reader shares the real-life situation, everyone secretly guesses: What percentage of our respondents thought the person was an ass: 25%, 50%, 75%, or... everyone? Once the results are revealed, players who guessed correctly earn tokens. The game continues until one perceptive player expertly navigates the scenarios and collects five tokens to win!

title: Voice of Command (HB) (OOS)
body:
THE STORY
Saint Stanislava's Adoration was once the Maelstrom Zone's finest shrine-city, and the crowning jewel of the planet Nymea. Now, it's a blasted, Chaos-infested ruin.

For two years Imperial forces have slowly unpicked the Archenemy's grip on the world, finger by finger, and Adoration is all that stands between Humanity and victory.

For Colonel Gabriel 'Venom' Velterson, leader of the 2002nd Cadian Mechanised Regiment, the end cannot come quickly enough. When his troops are not bathed in the toxic light of a mysterious blue star, or enduring the endless heresy broadcast over the hijacked vox-network, they're being quarantined by the Inquisition or squandered by capricious Nymean commanders. Indeed, on the eve of the final assault, the Archenemy may be the least of his problems.

Will Adoration be the end of the campaign, or will it be the end of the regiment?

Written by Richard Swan.

title: Blackheart: Claws of the Maelstrom  (HB) (OOS)
body:
Huron Blackheart is Master of the Maelstrom by his own will, not that of the gods he spurns.

Driven from Chogoris, Huron continues to bait the White Scars throughout the burning ruins of the Yasan Sector, hungry for the victory he believes he deserves. Yet as his schemes and insults threaten to ensnare the sons of Jaghatai, a new threat emerges. Out of the tumult of the Cicatrix Maledictum, the Great Devourer pours into Huron’s domain. The tyranids threaten not only his war, but all he has built since the fall of Badab.

Forced to rely upon makeshift allies and torn between spite and necessity, Huron Blackheart must decide where his loyalties truly lie, before xenos claws tear his empire asunder.

Written by Marc Collins.

title: Journal Tactica: Prospero Burns – The Judgement Of Valdor
body:
This 48-page softcover supplement contains:
– In-depth Lore: Detailed background on the Custodians’ role in the Burning of Prospero, and of the elements of the Legio Custodes which joined the Censure Host.
– Additional Mission: A full Historical Mission that allows players to recreate the Fall of the Domus Tenebri which pitted the Daemons of Tzeentch against the Emperor’s Custodians.
– Daemons of Tzeentch Army List: A full Army List for the Daemons of Tzeentch including a new Psychic Discipline and rules which allow these Units to be included in Thousand Sons Armies.
– Unit Profiles: Additional rules for a new Adjutorum Sodality unit for the Legio Custodes, and 2 new cohorts for the Solar Auxilia.

This is a set of 20 six-sided dice with rounded edges for use in games of Warhammer: The Horus Heresy, themed around the Legio Custodes. title: Legio Custodes Support Battle Group
body:
This boxed set builds 6 multipart plastic Legio Custodes or Adeptus Custodes miniatures:
– 1 Telemon Heavy Dreadnought
– 1 Pallas Grav-attack
– 4 Gyrfalcon Jetbike Sodality

The miniatures in this box are easy to customise. The Telemon Heavy Dreadnought is equipped with 1 shoulder-mounted Spiculus missile launcher, and 2 Telemon caestus with twin neutronium cascade projectors, one of which can be replaced with 1 flexible iliastus accelerator culverin, 1 high-damage adrathic desolator, or 1 armour-ruining arachnus storm cannon. The legs can be posed in 2 different positions, the elbows and fingers of each caestus can be posed, and you can choose from one of 2 waist armour designs, 2 helmet bases, and 3 helmet crowns.

The Pallas Grav-attack can be equipped with either a centreline-mounted twin arachnus blaze cannon, or twin iliastus accelerator fusil.

The Gyrfalcon Jetbikes can each be assembled with 1 adrathic devastator, 1 arachnus volley cannon, 1 twin corvae las-pulser, or 1 lastrum bolt cannon. The riders can be built with their solarite power lance mounted to the jetbike, or held in their hand in one of 3 positions. There are 3 helmet plumes to choose from.

Contents:
– 536 plastic components
– 4 Citadel 90mm by 52mm Oval Bases
– 1 Citadel 105mm by 70mm Oval Base
– 1 Citadel 100mm Round Base
– 1 Citadel Custodes Vehicle Flight Stem
– 4 Citadel 50mm Flying Ball Stems
– 1 Legio Custodes Vehicle Transfer Sheet
– 1 Legio Custodes Dreadnought Transfer Sheet
– 1 construction guide

The Legio Custodes Vehicle Transfer Sheet features 210 high-quality waterslide transfers, and the Custodes Dreadnought Transfer Sheet contains 160 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include icons, script, honorifics, and filigree to decorate your miniatures.

title: DCeased: Green Lantern Corpse Expansion
body:
The Green Lantern Corps, an intergalactic peacekeeping force using their willpower to wield the might of their Power Rings, shoudl be the universe's greatest hope in stopping the spread of the Anti-Life virus. However, even these bastions of heroism are not immune to it and must stand together against the wave of fear that threatens the galaxy.

Green Lantern Corpse is a an expansion for DCeased that brings the full power (and terror) of the Green Lantern Corps. It includes a sinister Zombie Horde powered by fear and four new Missions to explore all the gameplay possibilities of wielding Power Rings in the battle against Anti-Life, whether in brightest day or blackest night.

title: DCeased: Gotham Knights Expansion
body:
The Batman family alone has defended Gotham City from crime and violence. But in its darkest hour, Batman and many of the Gotham Knights have fallen prey to the Anti-Life virus, joining in the carnage with the rest of the hordes.

It's up to the few surviving heroes to keep the beacon of hope lit in Gotham City's night skies.

Gotham Knights is an expansion for DCeased that brings the battle against the Anti-Life to the mean streets of Gotham City, inside Wayne Manor, and all the way down to the Batcave.

Batman, his allies, and his enemies, have been scattered between both sides of this deadly conflict. Not even an arsenal of Bat-gadgets might be enough to succeed in your missions, with a horde of unliving Talons hunting you from the shadows!

title: DCeased: Arkham Asylum Expansion
body:
As the Anti-Life virus made its way through the inmate population of Arkham Asylum, the criminals whose sanity may have been already hanging by a thread completely lost their minds! Any surviving villains hoping to escape this blind madness will need to join the remaining heroes in fighting back against their former partners-in-crime.

Arkham Asylum is a n expansion for DCeased that brings Batman's legendary rogues gallery to the game in the form of bother Super Heroes and Zombie Hordes. These Super-Villains have to make use of their most devious tactics in thef ight against Anti-Life, especially since its' not only their former accomplices that are now undead, but also the hulking Titan-infused inmates.

Try to not lose your mind as you not only fight your way thorugh the eerie corridors of Arkham Asylum, but also make your escape through the dark tunnels of Gotham's sewers.

title: DCeased Core Box
body:
Darkseid unwittingly unleashed a techno-organic virus that quickly turned people into feral zombies who exist only to spread Anti-Life by killing or infecting all living beings. Not even the Justice League is safe from the virus, tearing itself apart.

Assemble your Super Hero team, muster all the power you can, and stand against the DCeased.

DCeased is a cooperative game where 1 to 6 players control the last uninfected Super Heroes facing off against Zombie Heroes and Horde Zombies controlled by the game itself. The goal is to complete Mission Objectives, defeat Enemies, and rescue Bystanders. Eliminating zombies gives Super Heroes the experience needed to become even more powerful. But the stronger they are, the more zombies appear to hunt them down!

Only by working together and pushing their powers to the limit can the Super Heroes hope to put an end to the Anti-Life threat!

title: NERF K-Pop Demon Hunters - Mira's Curved Moon Sword
body:
The Nerf KPop Demon Hunters Mira's Curved Moon Sword is inspired by the one from the Netflix animated film!

It captures the look of the sword used by Mira, HUNTR/X singer and demon hunter in the musical fantasy about a KPop girl group that secretly doubles as a trio of demon hunters. Mira is the lead dancer and choreographer in the HUNTR/X group and wields the Curved Moon Sword to battle demons. The 36-inch sword has a foam blade with pearlescent decoration and a plastic core and a plastic hilt. It's perfect accessories for role play, cosplay, and epic demon-fighting adventures.

Expand the imaginative games with and build your KPop Demon Hunters collection with Zoey's Spirit Blades and Rumi's Four Tiger Sword (each sold separately, subject to availability).

Features:

  • NERF KPOP DEMON HUNTERS MIRA'S CURVED MOON SWORD: Kids can imagine themselves as favorite character Mira from the demon-hunting HUNTR/X KPop girl group with Mira's signature sword
  • INSPIRED BY KPOP DEMON HUNTERS: The sword captures the look of the one used by singer and demon hunter Mira in the animated film KPop Demon Hunters
  • FOAM BLADE: The sword has a foam blade decorated with a pearlescent finish, and it has a plastic hilt
  • 36 INCHES LONG: The sword measures 36 inches (91 centimeters) in length when fully assembled
  • KPOP DEMON HUNTERS MIRA: Demon hunter Mira is the lead dancer and choreographer in the HUNTR/X KPop girl group
  • BUILD YOUR DEMON HUNTING COLLECTION: Look for the KPop Demon Hunters Zoey's Spirit Blades and Rumi's Four Tiger Sword for epic demon-hunting adventures (each sold separately, subject to availability)
  • COOL KIDS GIFTS: Great as outdoor summer toys, birthday gifts, backyard games, non-candy Easter basket ideas, and holiday gifts for boys, girls and teens

Includes: 1 sword (2 pieces)

  • Ages 6 & Up
  • WARNING: CHOKING HAZARD – Small parts may be generated. Not for children under 3 years.
  • CAUTION: Do not swing, poke or jab at people or animals. Discontinue use if core is exposed.
  • Assembly required.
  • Colors, packaging, accessories, and decorations may vary and are subject to change.

title: Berserk Vol. 33
body: Guts the Black Swordsman and his companions brave the open sea, hoping to reach Puck's homeland, Elfhelm, and its powerful elven king, who might be able to restore the sanity of Guts' former lover, Casca. But seeking out a sanctuary for Casca means that Guts must postpone his hunt for his ex-friend and leader, Griffith, who has been reborn as a demon lord hell-bent on conquest. The winds of change blow fast and hard across the war-torn lands of the Holy See, and if Guts waits too long to exact his vengeance, Griffith might attain his murderous goals before Guts can return to Midland to stop him!

title: Berserk Vol. 24
body: Desperate to find a sanctuary where his lover, Casca, will be safe from the demons drawn to her Brand of Sacrifice, Guts the Black Swordsman pushes his motley band of followers onward towards fairy Puck’s homeland, Elfhelm. With new allies who make their home in a mystically guarded woodland paradise, Guts’ goal seems within reach, but danger lurks in the shadows of even the most dazzling utopias, and even fairy witchery may not protect the wondrous kingdom from an army of marauding, murderous trolls!

title: Berserk Vol. 36
body: What Guts the Black Swordsman and his companions had seen as an island refuge for monstrous sea creatures and the ghost ship of the demonic Bonebeard is, in fact, the very lair of the malefic sea god that controls them. With no avenue of escape, Guts must once again don the Berserker armor to give his company any chance of survival. But without the protective influence of the sorceress Schierke, Guts risks being forever lost within the cursed armor and becoming an even greater threat to his comrades!

title: Berserk Vol. 38
body:
Guts the Black Swordsman and company reach the isle of Skellig in hopes that Elven magic can cure the afflicted Casca, but the cure could come at a deadly cost. Meanwhile, Guts’ Band of the Hawk comrade Rickert journeys to the city of Falconia, the seat of power for Griffith, the resurrected former Hawks commander. But the glittering towers of Falconia cast the darkest of shadows, and a legion of demonic monstrosities dwell in the darkness!
 
From creator Kentaro Miura comes Berserk, a sprawling adult fantasy epic of fierce imagination

One of the most popular long-running adult manga series ever published.

title: Berserk Vol. 11
body: The Band of the Hawk — what's left of them — are on the run, Guts and Casca having rescued the Hawks' leader, Griffith, from the horrors of the King of Midland's dungeons. Starved, tortured mercilessly and imprisoned in an iron mask, Griffith hangs to life and sanity by a thread… and he'll be no help against the King's latest charges sent to bring him back to pay for his dalliance with the King's daughter. Now the depleted Hawks will have to face the Knights of the Black Dog, led by the merciless, bestial Wyald… one bad dog who's even worse when he unleashes the beast within!

title: Marvel: Remix The Cosmos
body:
Expand your Marvel Remix experience with new teams, new combinations, and new strategies. Players recruit heroes, allies, and locations from across the Marvel Universe, including The Fantastic Four, Guardians of the Galaxy, Captain Marvel, Silver Surfer, Doctor Strange, Ms. Marvel, She-Hulk, and more! Equip characters with iconic gear and face off against infamous villains like Venom and Doctor Doom.

Each player begins with a hand of seven cards representing characters, items, or places from the Marvel Universe. On your turn, draw from the Hero deck, the Villain deck, or a shared discard pile, then discard one card from your hand.

Get ready for an epic Superhero battle!

 • Designed by Bruce Glassco, Marvel: Remix the Cosmos is based on the acclaimed game Fantasy Realms, which was nominated for the 2021 Kennerspiel des Jahres!

 • Introduces Cosmic cards with immediate effects and big bonuses, including all six Infinity Stones!

 • Fully playable as a standalone game, or add to Marvel: Remix for even more explosive combos!

Ages: 12+
Players: 2-6
Game Length: 20 minutes

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Icons of the Realms - Hollow Dragon
body:
Unlike dragons who explore the magic of undeath for power, the Hollow Dragon sees it as a means to pursue its noble purpose. For the sake of protecting an artifact or fulfilling an oath, these dragons transform into a husk of their former selves, accepting undeath and filling themselves with radiant energy until that purpose is fulfilled. This ghostly guardian is ready to test your players' mettle and will make a striking addition to your Dungeons & Dragons miniature collection.

Features:

 • Pre-painted, fully assembled, and ready right out of the box!

 • Includes one Huge miniature on a 100mm clear base with a 75mm Threat Ring.

 • Features DungeonGlo glow-in-the-dark paint on body and wings (for best glow results, charge under sunlight/UV light).

Made by a brand that has been making candies since 1919, these treats deliver an authentic experience in every drop. Proudly Made in the U.S.A., they are a timeless classic worthy of the candy jar.

title: Victor Martinez 2003 Topps Signature Moves On Card Auto
body: Rare on-card autograph from Victor Martinez's 2003 Topps Signature rookie era. This vintage baseball card captures the future Hall of Fame candidate's authentic signature, making it a must-have for serious collectors. The Signature Moves series is highly sought after for its premium player selections and limited print runs. Excellent condition and authenticity make this a valuable addition to any sports card collection.

title: Shohei Ohtani 2019 Panini Donruss Action All Stars Vector
body:
Shohei Ohtani's 2019 Panini Donruss Action All Stars Vector card captures the two-way phenom in dynamic form. This premium trading card features vibrant vector-style artwork that brings Ohtani's explosive athleticism to life, making it a standout addition to any baseball card collection.

Perfect for fans of the Japanese superstar or serious collectors seeking rare Panini releases from his early MLB years. The Action All Stars insert set highlights baseball's most exciting players with distinctive modern design and sharp detail.

A collectible piece of baseball history documenting Ohtani's legendary 2019 season.

title: Brach's Classic Chewy Caramels 10oz
body: A fall favorite for generations, Brach's Classic Chewy Caramels are rich, creamy, and perfectly chewy! Each piece is individually wrapped, making them ideal for snacking, sharing, or melting into your favorite fall recipes. Whether you’re crafting caramel apples, stirring up a decadent dip, or sneaking a piece straight from the bag, these caramels are your go-to for sweet autumn memories.

title: Brach's Mellowcreme Pumplins 11oz Bag
body: Brach’s Mellowcreme Pumpkins deliver the classic Candy Corn flavor you love in a fun, festive pumpkin shape! These plump bites of mellowcreme are perfect for snacking, baking, or using as a sweet and colorful accent in your fall decorations. A must-have for Candy Corn fans who want more of that iconic honey-sweet taste in every bite.

title: Brach's Candy Corn 11oz Bag
body:
The candy that defines fall!

Brach's Classic Candy Corn delivers that signature tri-color look and honey-forward flavor that candy lovers have adored for generations. With its smooth, chewy texture and unmistakable taste, this nostalgic treat is a must-have for Halloween parties, baking projects, and festive candy bowls.

title: Josh Bard 2003 Upper Deck SPX Young Stars Auto Jersey /1295
body: Josh Bard 2003 Upper Deck SPX Young Stars Auto Jersey card — a limited edition collectible from the prestigious SPX set. Features an authentic autograph and game-worn jersey swatch embedded directly into the card. Numbered 1/1295, this rookie-era card captures Bard during his early MLB career. SPX Young Stars cards are highly sought after by serious collectors for their premium production quality and scarcity. Perfect for baseball card enthusiasts and Josh Bard fans building vintage auto collections.

title: Vidal Gummi Eyeballs 4.4lb
body: When you want to creep out your friends and family with some delightfully scary Halloween candy, what better to turn to than gummy eyeballs from Vidal? Each eyeball features a deliciously sweet strawberry and creme flavor and looks positively scary for Halloween. This 4.4-pound bag contains about 224 gummy eyeballs. These are not wrapped! Place them in a bowl at your next spooky party.

title: Pete Crow-Armstrong 2020 Topps Bowman Chrome 1st Rookie (PCA)
body:
Elevate your baseball card collection with this rare 2020 Topps Bowman Chrome rookie card featuring Pete Crow-Armstrong (PCA). This early prospect card captures a defining moment in the young athlete's career, showcasing the premium chrome finish and vibrant imagery that Bowman Chrome is known for.

Perfect for collectors seeking first-edition rookie cards of emerging MLB talent. The chrome technology delivers striking color saturation and a modern aesthetic that stands out in any display. Whether you're building a prospect collection or investing in future hall-of-fame potential, this authentic baseball memorabilia piece offers both nostalgia and growth opportunity.

Condition and grading may vary. Ideal for enthusiasts and serious collectors alike.

title: Ronald Acuna Jr 2018 Topps Chrome Update Rookie
body: Rare rookie card of Ronald Acuña Jr from 2018 Topps Chrome Update series. This iconic chrome rookie features sharp imagery and modern card stock quality. A must-have for baseball collectors and Acuña enthusiasts seeking this pivotal early-career card. Condition and centering vary by copy.

body: Unearth a hauntingly fun transformation of a chocolate classic with Twix Ghoulish Green Cookie Bars. These Halloween-themed Twix bars feature an eerie bright green cookie center hidden beneath rich caramel and smooth milk chocolate. Delivering the exact same crunch and flavor fans crave, the spooky color shock makes every bite feel like a Halloween surprise. They make an unbeatable choice for filling out concession stands, grabbing customer attention at checkout registers, or adding a monstrous twist to party favor bags!

You know what they say: “married in red, better off dead!” …at least as long as Betelgeuse is the groom. title: Demolisher (Paperback) (OOS)
body:
A lauded battle tank of the Imperium is tasked with leading a convoy, escorting a high-value asset through enemy territory. Recent changes to the crew threaten to destabilise the delicate harmony of the whole, to potentially disastrous effect. This edition includes an additional short story.

READ IT BECAUSE
The crew from the novel Steel Tread return, and it's another chance to get into the armoured hull of a mighty battle tank and find out what makes them tick. Their relationships and ability to work together can spell the difference between glorious victory and ignoble death. Can they come together in time to complete their mission?

THE STORY
The war for warp-cursed Croatoas rages on. Hailed as ‘Giant-killers’ for their heroics during Operation Jotunn, Lieutenant Commander Hadeya Etsul and the crew of the Leman Russ Demolisher Steel Tread are hurled right back into battle.

Assigned command of a convoy of armour and infantry, Etsul is tasked with escorting a legendary lord commissar through contested territory to stabilise the wavering Ruega Front. But with a new crew member disturbing the delicate harmony of her tank, and a malevolent nemesis lurking unseen in the high passes ahead, the mission proves even more dangerous than first thought.

As Etsul’s troubles multiply, she is forced to risk everything – even the hard-won trust of her crew – in the name of duty.

Written by Andy Clark.

title: Ghazghkull Thraka: Prophet of the Waaagh! (Illustrated and Annotated Edition) (OOS)
body:
Ghazghkull Thraka, the Beast of Armageddon, is one of the greatest threats to the Imperium. Read his full story as told to the Inquisition by his faithful banner bearer, Makari.

READ IT BECAUSE
Get a grot's-eye view of the inexorable rise of the greatest ork warboss since the Great Beast, in a novel packed with all the action and dark humour you'd expect from an ork tale.

THE STORY
Of the billions of orks who swarm the galaxy, the name of one strikes fear into the hearts of human and xenos alike – Ghazghkull Mag Uruk Thraka.
The Warlord of Warlords.
The Beast of Armageddon.
The Prophet of the Waaagh!.
With his tusks, fists, and power claw, he does the holy work of Gork and Mork – and soon all worlds will burn in his bootprints.

Mystery shrouds the origins of such a beast as Ghazghkull Thraka. Rumours abound that the mighty warlord was once just like any other ork – but if that is the case, how did he rise from a lowly lad to the biggest of bosses?

Many have lost their minds trying to unravel the secrets behind his rise, and Lord Inquisitor Tytonida Falx is no different. She has headed into the murky depths of heresy to find the answer – but this time, something is different. This time, she has something the others did not. She has custody of the one creature in the universe who claims to know the truth of it all – Ghazghkull’s banner bearer, Makari the Grot.

Written by Nate Crowley.

Features of this illustrated and annotated hardcover edition include:
– 15 striking illustrations to complement the story
– Author commentary in the form of 123 annotations throughout
– Striking cover with metallic green details
– An introduction by the author
– Black and green printed page edges, including artwork of a grot
– A green ribbon bookmark

title: Orks Dice (OOS)
body:
When they form a Waaagh!, Orks swarm across a planet in unending waves of raucous, frenetic violence. They cry out for their gods, Gork and Mork, to witness their acts of brutality and cunning.

This is a set of 16 six-sided dice with squared edges for use in games of Warhammer 40,000, themed around the Orks. They are cast in green acrylic plastic with red ink markings, and measure 16mm along each edge. The 1-5 facings are traditionally pipped, and each '6' face is decorated with the savage icon of the Orks.

title: Command Pack: Orks
body:
Command Your Waaagh!

This Command Pack includes 94 cards and 36 double-sided tokens to help you reference and track your Ork army’s special rules in games of Warhammer 40,000. You'll find a double-sided token reference card, and cards for 15 detachments, including all their special rules, stratagems, and enhancements.

Contents:
– 15 Detachment Rule cards
– 39 Enhancement cards
– 40 Stratagem cards
– 36 Double-sided tokens
– 1 Token reference card

All cards measure 63mm by 88mm.

You'll need a copy of Codex: Orks, which is available separately, to make full use of this set.

title: Codex: Orks 2026 Refresh
body:
Inside this 176-page softcover book, you'll find:
– A full lore section with background material, historical notes, evocative artwork, a description of various units, and inspiring photography, giving you insight into Ork society
– A collecting section containing advice on building a thematic army and working towards detachments, with painting guides and tips about creating a themed battlefield
– A rules section with the army special rules, 15 detachments, and 54 datasheets you'll need to field your Orks as an effective fighting force on the tabletop
– A gatefold on both the front and back cover, featuring photography, a galactic map tracking the Orks across space, and an Inquisitorial report on Ork activity in various war zones

This book is presented in an easy-to-carry 185mm by 250mm softcover format with a removable slipcase.

Inside the back cover, you’ll find a unique code that will unlock the Orks faction in Warhammer 40,000: The App, including ongoing access to more free Orks content over time.

title: Orks: Wartrakk
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds a Wartrakk, a mobile but stable firing platform for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Just as fast as a Warbike, but equipped with more dakka and a vicious Nob, this light vehicle is perfect for riding alongside your Speed Freek units to add some extra hitting power. Armed with a recklessly rapid-firing blitzkannon and a multi-busta launcha to unleash hails of missiles, they can take on everything from masses of infantry to light armour. This multipart plastic kit builds a Weirdboy, a support character for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Capable of blasting the foe with a torrent of power vomit at mid-range, and whacking them with his copper staff in melee, he deserves a place in your front lines.
