title: Orks: Boyz
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds 1 Nob, 9 Boyz, and 1 Ammo Runt, indispensable infantry warriors for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Armed with choppas, sluggas, and shootas, they are a threat at range and in the swirl of melee. No matter the size of your Ork army, you'll need plenty of Boyz to take and hold objectives and keep the pressure on your enemies.

Kustomise Your Boyz

The Nob can be assembled with either a kustom choppa or power klaw and a kombi-skorcha, or a two-handed big choppa, with your choice of 2 bosspoles and 4 different heads. One of the Boyz can be assembled with an optional big shoota, another with a burna, and yet another with a rokkit launcha. This versatile kit also includes several interchangeable parts, allowing you to customise your Boyz in a variety of ways.

title: Orks: Warbikers
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds 3 Warbikers, fast and deadly mounted warriors for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Each bike is a heavily modified and personalised steed with jagged armour plates, jutting tailpipes, and chunky tyres, armed with dual dakkaguns mounted to the front. The Biker Nob is equipped with a dual combi-rokkit for added firepower. If you're looking for a fast unit that's effective both at range and in melee, these brutal bikers are for you.

Kustomise Your Warbikes

One of the riders can be assembled as an optional Biker Nob, with 2 boss poles and 2 different heads to choose from, unique arms, larger tailpipes, a distinctive front armour plate, handlebars, and rokkits. This versatile kit also includes several interchangeable parts, allowing you to customise your Warbikers in a variety of ways.

title: Peelerz - Mummy Snacks 6oz Peg Bag
body:
Somewhere deep inside an ancient candy tomb, somebody apparently unwrapped a mummy and thought, "You know what this needs? More gummy texture." And honestly, they absolutely nailed it.

Amos Halloween Peelerz Gummy Mummy Candy is pure spooky season chaos wrapped in creepy mummy vibes. These soft, chewy, peelable gummies are ridiculously fun to eat — literally peel them apart layer by layer before devouring them like a sugar-crazed archaeologist who just found cursed treasure. Weirdly satisfying. Like edible bubble wrap, but infinitely more delicious and way less responsible.

Throw them in your Halloween candy bowl, devour them during a horror movie marathon, toss them in trick-or-treat hauls, or dramatically announce you've awakened an ancient candy curse every time you crack open the bag. Fair warning: once you start peeling, you won't stop.

The mummy aesthetic? Already winning. Wrapped head to toe, wandering around mysteriously, somehow surviving thousands of years? That's commitment to a bit we respect.

Each 6oz bag is packed with chewy peelable gummy goodness — enough spooky snacks to dominate the entire Halloween season, one movie marathon, or a genuinely questionable late-night snack spiral.

Chewy. Fruity. Dangerously addictive.

title: MARVEL MULTIVERSE RPG SECRET WARS EXPANSION
body:
Everything you need to know about the Secret Wars Expansion for the Marvel Multiverse Role-Playing Game!

Developed in-house, Marvel’s d616 System features three six-sided dice to make the game accessible and easy to learn for both new and veteran RPG fans alike.

The Multiverse has been destroyed, and God Emperor Doom rules over its shattered pieces in a single patchwork planet: Battleworld. MARVEL MULTIVERSE ROLE-PLAYING GAME: SECRET WARS EXPANSION takes a deep dive into the event that changed Marvel forever, including an adventuring framework for players to fight their way through Battleworld and save the entire Marvel Multiverse. It also includes an exploration of the Fantastic Four, Doctor Doom, the Guardians of the Galaxy and the vast Marvel cosmos — including new rules for how to handle Rank X characters of unbelievable might!

This RPG expansion is intended for use with the MARVEL MULTIVERSE ROLE-PLAYING GAME: CORE RULEBOOK.

title: Marvel: Crisis Protocol Alliances - Night of the Goblin
body:
New York once again finds itself at the mercy of the Green Goblin and it’s up to the team of the Spider-Men: Peter Parker and Miles Morales, together with Black Cat and Ghost-Spider, to put an end to his menacing machinations!

Marvel: Crisis Protocol Alliances - Night of the Goblin is a cooperative adventure game for up to four players. Players work together to thwart each of the Green Goblin’s sinister plots throughout the city, but stopping this nefarious villain won’t be easy. Players will have to fight their way through hordes of minions including the numerous Goblin Army goons, robotic Spider-Slayers, and deadly War Goblins. As players defeat enemies and complete each encounter, they will earn valuable experience, allowing them to level up and customize their hero with new and more powerful abilities. Abilities they will certainly need in order to triumph in their ultimate showdown with the Green Goblin himself! 

  • COOPERATIVE MARVEL ADVENTURE: Team up as Spider-Man, Miles Morales, Ghost-Spider, and Black Cat to stop Green Goblin’s citywide chaos.
  • EPIC BOSS BATTLES & ENEMIES: Fight through waves of Goblin Army goons, Spider-Slayers, and War Goblins before facing the Green Goblin himself.
  • LEVEL UP & CUSTOMIZE HEROES: Gain experience, unlock powerful abilities, and evolve your characters throughout the campaign.
  • COMPLETE GAME EXPERIENCE: Includes miniatures, dice, boards, tokens, and cards—everything needed for cooperative gameplay out of the box.
  • IMMERSIVE STORY-DRIVEN GAMEPLAY: Progress through dynamic encounters across New York City with evolving challenges and replayability.

Contents:

2 Double-Sided Stage Boards, 4 Character Dashboards, 18 Enemy Minion Miniatures, 1 Boss Green Goblin Miniature, 4 Character Miniatures, 4 Alliances Character Stat Cards, 5 MCP Stat Cards, 4 Player Stamina Cubes, 4 Player Power Cubes, 4 Player XP Cubes, 44 Alliances Character Level-Up Cards, 5 Stage Cards, 1 Boss Battle Card, 3 Enemy Minion Stat Cards, 1 Boss Stat Card, 1 Enemy Modifier Card, 1 Pitfall Card, 4 Rules Reference Cards, 1 Enemy Tracker Punch, 16 special condition tokens, 20 damage tokens , 5 Daze tokens, 6 Terrain Tokens, 6 Objective Tokens,6 Challenge Tokens, 1 Priority Token, 20 Stage Tokens, 10 Activation Tokens, 10 Dice, 1 Rulebook

title: Transformers Age of the Primes - Vector Prime Action Figure
body:
Experience the epic universe of Transformers robots with the Transformers The Thirteen Vector Prime figure! The 7-inch (17.5 cm) Voyager Class figure converts from robot to spacecraft mode in 22 steps. With intricate poseability and attachable accessories like the Blade of Time artifact and Cyber Key, this Transformers action figure makes an awesome addition to any collection. Look for more Age of the Primes Transformers collectibles featuring Primes, Autobots, Decepticons, and more to create a lineup that is - More Than Meets the Eye.

Product Features

  • 7-inch scale (17.5cm)
  • Made of plastic
  • Based on the Transformers franchise
  • Converts from robot to spacecraft in 22 steps
  • Voyager class
  • Premium detail
  • Fully articulated

Box Contents

  • Cyber Key

Transformers Age of the Primes - Swindle Action Figure
body:
• Transformers Combaticon Swindle figure is 6.5 inches (16.5 cm) in robot mode and features deco and details inspired by the Transformers universe.

  • Converts from robot to vehicle mode in 21 steps.

  • Combine all Combaticon figures (each sold separately, subject to availability) to make the imposing Bruticus combiner figure!

  • Combaticon Swindle comes with blaster and missile accessories that attach in both modes.

  • Age of the Primes Transformers figures feature articulation for display-worthy poses.

  • Combaticon Swindle, descended from Liege Maximo, is an opportunistic entrepreneur.

 

Before the war, even before the Autobots and Decepticons, there were The Thirteen Primes. Every bot, battle, and power in the Transformers universe can be traced back to them. The Age of the Primes line celebrates their epic legacy with a far-reaching collection that touches nearly every corner of the lore. Build your lineup to create a display that is — More Than Meets the Eye.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Arcana Unleashed - Deadfall Adventure Expansion Book (Reg. Cover)
body:
Deep in the Forgotten Realms, the nation of Thay—notorious for its tyrannical, red-robed wizards—casts an ominous shadow on your table. Secrets are passed in the dark; a looming threat of unimagined power seeks to crumble societies, and one name is at the center of it all—Szass Tam.

Dive into the world of enchanted espionage, fragile alliances, and clandestine missions in this magical spy thriller adventure built for high-level play (levels 11–20). Will you be bold enough to face the might of the lich Szass Tam—and stop him before he unleashes his demonic undead horde upon the world? Or will you let it all fall to ruin?

Contents:
  • Level 11–20 adventure, plus Thay Gazetteer
  • 14 magical items
  • 6 high-CR creatures, including stat block for Szass Tam and advice on how to play him
  • 5 chapters detailing the adventure with 20+ dedicated maps
  • Advice on how to run a magical spy thriller and adventures in Thay

title: Cosmic Encounter (DISC)
body:
Who—or what—is out there?

Eons ago, your ancestors searched the black void of space for intelligent life. Their search proved fruitless. They were alone. Desolate, they used their technology to send the seeds of life to inhabitable planets across the galaxies. Over millions of years, the alien species evolved, but before the ancestors could see the fruits of their labor, they disappeared. 

To aid their children, your ancestors left behind a legacy of advanced technology and hyperspace gates- gifts to encourage communication and harmony between their children. But without the guide of an elder, you and your distant alien cousins must learn to communicate, negotiate, and coexist. 

Welcome to the Cosmic Age. The open skies of countless worlds are filled with speeding spaceships, and a panoply of alien species compete to populate the galaxy. Will your people choose to occupy undefended worlds, create peaceful civilizations, or ruthlessly conquer foreign planets? In the quest to colonize the vast cosmos, there are as many paths to victory as there are aliens seeking it. Peace, war, negotiation, betrayal—you never know what will happen in the next encounter!

Ages: 14+
Players: 3-5
Play Time: 1-2 Hrs.

title: Concept (DISC)
body:
A large, green animal from long ago? Must be a dinosaur. Water, cube and cold weather? Has to be an ice cube. A man with a job who rides large brown animals in the United States? Is that a cowboy? In Concept, players team up to place tokens on a board covered in icons, depicting everything from ancient samurai and snails to Leonardo DiCaprio. Points go to the player who can guess the correctly by looking at the various symbols, but in this wild party game, the points are less important than just having a great time!

Ages: 4+
Players: 2-10
Play Time: 40 Min.

title: Captain Sonar: Operation Dragon
body:
Captain Sonar: Operation Dragon, an expansion for Captain Sonar, consists of an "Operation Dragon" campaign as well as a "Custom Pack" toolbox. A few details:

• In search of rare minerals, the crews dive to never-before-seen depths where the laws of physics reach their limits. In the "Operation Dragon" campaign mode, teams can play seven consecutive missions on ever-new nautical charts, using expert characters with abilities exclusive to them to make it through this adventure. The result of each game affects the next mission...

• The "Custom Pack" toolbox contains four new modules with new options to vary your gaming experience, such as "Armada" mode, new second stations, and new mechanics stations.

title: Kamigami Battles: Battle of the Nine Realms (DISC)
body:
In Kamigami Battles, you will play as one of the Gods of mythology competing for dominion over the realm. You will recruit ancient Warriors and Disciples to fight in epic battles against the Gods trying to conquer your world! Each God has a pool of life force called energy, and by reducing a God to 0 energy, you can either kill or seal that God away! Players can choose to pair up with their friends in Team Match or wage war on all those who oppose them in Free-For-All. In a Team Match, 4 or 6 players team up in pairs of two, with one player the Main God and the other the Support God, to be the last standing after eliminating all of the opposing Main Gods. In Free-for-All, 2 to 6 players battle for dominance by either eliminating all other Gods or by being first to reach 25 energy. Includes promo pack!

body: Experience the combined might of divine magic and musical invocation! The wise Cleric and charismatic Bard may take different approaches to adventuring, but both remain skilled and versatile additions to any aspiring group of adventurers! Whether you're employing the Dwarf Cleric's divinely-granted powers or utilizing the Tiefling Bard's aptitude for magic through song, dance, and verse, this pack offers two wonderful new additions to your player character miniature collection!

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Nolzur's Marvelous Unpainted Miniature - W29 Knight & Mage Apprentice
body: Allies of all experience levels! A brave warrior of Cormyr and an aspiring mage of the Lords' Alliance come together in one mighty pack. Whether you need the steadfast bravery of a Purple Dragon Knight or wish to explore arcane knowledge with the Lords' Alliance Mage, this set is a great option for expanding your party's encounters.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Nolzur's Marvelous Unpainted Miniature - W29 Cultist of Bhaal & Cultist of Myrkul
body: Murder, necromancy, and cultists most foul! Members of some of Faerun's most notorious cults, when Cultists of the Lord of Murder Bhaal or the Lord of Bones Myrkul are spotted, death and destruction are never far behind. Cultists of Bhaal revel in the carnage of murder, while the nefarious followers of Myrkul seek to terrorize the living by raising the dead. Whether encountered separately or as a pair, these fiendish zealots will prove a worthy challenge for any adventuring party.

Immortal guardians of culture, Guardian Naga possess perfect memories allowing them to preserve and pass on the tales of civilizations long lost to time. Often found among the ruins of cultures they outlived, Guardian Naga can be either valuable allies or dangerous celestial foes for an adventuring party to encounter. Whether you leave with ancient knowledge or face their wrath is up to you.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Nolzur's Marvelous Unpainted Miniature - W29 Axe Beak
body: Flightless, but not fight-less! Named for their distinctive and deadly beaks, flightless Axe Beaks are strong, stubborn hunters capable of stalking prey either alone or in small packs. Axe Beaks can be found everywhere from tropical plains to arctic tundras, with plumage as varied as the environments they inhabit. These versatile birds offer many opportunities for the creative painter to shine.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Nolzur's Marvelous Unpainted Miniature - W29 Lamia
body: Beware the dangerous illusions of the Lamia. Strong and cunning, the half-lion Lamia is equally skilled at both trickery and raw strength. Frequently found near ruins, these fiends often use their spellcasting skills to craft powerful illusions and lure unsuspecting travelers into their service. Will you outwit this sinister trickster, or will your party find itself tangled in one of its dangerous pacts?

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Nolzur's Marvelous Unpainted Miniature - W29 Phaerimm Agent
body: An ancient evil re-emerges. Imprisoned since ancient times underneath the great desert of Anauroch, the Phaerimm Agent seeks to travel the surface world in search of powerful magic for its malevolent purposes. Intent on dominating all other sentient beings, these dangerous hovering spellcasters make for a truly terrifying enemy encounter. Can your party withstand the magic of this ancient evil?

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Nolzur's Marvelous Unpainted Miniature - W29 Cultist of Bane & Dwarf Zhentilar Soldier
body: Where tyranny and ambition thrive, the Cultists of Bane and Zhentilar Soldiers are never far behind. Whether serving the Lord of Darkness through the mercenary Zhentarim or more directly through the Cult of Bane, these zealots are forceful in both strength and conviction. Can your party hope to defeat their vicious machinations?

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Nolzur's Marvelous Unpainted Miniature - W29 Nimblewright Hulk
body: Created from a mixture of wood, metal, magic, and clockwork, Nimblewright Hulks are far more dangerous than their looming frames suggest. Despite their heavy steel plating, the dexterous movements of these constructs are matched only by their raw strength. Any adventuring party should be wary before squaring off against one. Will you be able to withstand their onslaught?

title: 2025 Topps Marvel Comic Book Heroes 1975 Golden Anniversary Hobby Box
body:
Celebrate 50 years of Marvel magic.

Marvel Comic Book Heroes Golden Anniversary brings the bold energy of the 1975 and 1976 Topps Marvel Comic Book Heroes stickers into the present day, reimagined with vibrant Chrome technology. This all-new trading card set fuses the nostalgic charm of the originals with the sharp, dynamic style of modern comic art, showcasing contemporary illustrations in the beloved vintage sticker designs. Collectors will discover rare autograph cards signed by legendary comic book artists, along with original art sketch cards from a standout roster of creators, making this set a must-have for Marvel fans and collectors alike.

The 150-card Base Set blends iconic artwork from the '75 and '76 releases with fresh visuals from the 2000s to today, all elevated by a sleek marble-inspired design that connects past and present in stunning fashion. Autograph cards feature artwork from classic Marvel illustrators, recreated in the style of the original stickers. Original art sketch cards offer one-of-a-kind creations from today's top comic talent, adding even more chase-worthy hits to this golden celebration.

Enhanced with chromium stock, the 2025 Topps Marvel Comic Book Heroes 1975 Golden Anniversary checklist is packed with artistic styles from different eras of Marvel.

Limited parallels include Gold Mini-Diamond Refractor (/199), Gold Atomic Refractor (/125) and more.

Configuration: 8 Packs Per Box, 4 Cards Per Pack

body:
THE STORY
Heldanarr Fall has nothing to live for. He has conquered the Burning Valley and bent its people to his will. Yet even as a Chaos Lord, he must kneel to a god of bloodshed who demands endless war. Then, in the ruins of a siege, he finds two children. Helpless. Innocent. Worth protecting. For the first time since his rise to power, Heldanarr sees a future worth fighting for – the chance to make a better world.

But enemies are closing in. Rivals circle his throne like crows, and omens whisper of Hammerhal's legions on the march. To defend what is his, he must call upon the power of Khorne. But the Lord of Skulls is not generous, and the price of his gifts may be precisely what Heldanarr Fall is determined to save.

Written by Noah Van Nguyen.

title: Galaxy in Flames (HB) (OOS)
body:
Ben Counter brings us this exciting third part of the opening trilogy to The Horus Heresy, setting in motion the cataclysmic events that will culminate in Horus laying siege to the birthplace of Humanity.

THE STORY
Having recovered from his grievous injuries, Warmaster Horus leads the triumphant Imperial forces against the rebel world of Isstvan III. Though the rebels are swiftly crushed, Horus's treachery is finally revealed when the planet is razed by virus bombs and Space Marines turn on their battle-brothers in the most bitter struggle imaginable.

Written by Ben Counter.

title: False Gods (PB) (OOS)
body:
READ IT BECAUSE
The seeds of Horus' betrayal are planted here, and the true nature of the universe revealed. Also, one of the Warhammer 40,000 universe's most reviled villains, Dark Apostle Erebus of the Word Bearers, reveals his true colours, and becomes the Space Marine you love to hate.

THE STORY
The Great Crusade that has taken humanity into the stars continues. The Emperor has handed the reins of command to his favoured son, the Warmaster Horus. Yet all is not well in the armies of the Imperium. Horus is still battling against the jealousy and resentment of his brother primarchs and, when he is injured on the planet Davin, he must also battle his inner daemons. With all the temptations that Chaos has to offer, can the weakened Horus resist?

Written by Graham McNeill.

title: Ogor Mawtribes Dice (OOS)
body: This is a set of 16 six-sided dice with rounded edges for use in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar, themed around the Ogor Mawtribes. They are cast in translucent frosted light grey acrylic plastic with black ink markings, and measure 16mm along each edge. The 1-5 facings are traditionally pipped, and each '6' face is decorated with the gaping maw icon of the Gulping God.

title: Destruction Battletome: Ogor Mawtribes
body:
This 114-page hardback book contains:
– Background, art, and fiction exploring the ravenous followers of the Gulping God
– A description of their many diverse units, along with detailed photography and artwork
– Faction rules including battle traits, battle formations, heroic traits, artefacts of power, Spells, and Prayers
– 26 warscrolls, covering every unit
– A Spearhead guide, including gameplay and hobby advice, along with its own set of warscrolls and army abilities for the Mawseeker Mob and the Warglutt Marauders
– Narrative Path to Glory rules, including the Anvil of Apotheosis, allowing you to create your own hero
– Rules for 3 thematic Armies of Renown and 2 Regiments of Renown that can be added to other Destruction armies
– A handy reference section with army abilities, magic, and battle traits
– An 8-page gatefold section, featuring background on the Hungry Hordes, Clans and Mawtribes, a Path of Consumption, and a map of the Ogor Domains

This book also contains a one-use code to unlock Destruction Battletome: Ogor Mawtribes content in Warhammer Age of Sigmar: The App.

title: Ogor Mawtribes : Gluttons
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds 5 Gluttons, hulking infantry warriors for your Ogor Mawtribes armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. These essential units form the core of an army – hard-hitting and very hard to kill, they are ideally suited for holding ground or rumbling forward to take vital objectives.

The kit includes components to build an optional Champion and a musician. One of the miniatures can be armed with a brutal two-handed hammer, and 2 of the miniatures each come with 2 optional bag accessories. The kit comes with 22 different male and female head options – 2 bare heads and 2 helmeted heads for the champion, 10 helmeted heads, and 8 bare heads.

Interchangeable parts:
– 5 hammers
– 5 swords
– 5 right hand knuckle-dusters
– 3 left hand knuckle-dusters

Contents:
– 101 plastic components
– 5 Citadel 40mm Round Bases
– 1 construction guide

title: Ogor Mawtribes: Grell Firefist
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds Grell Firefist, a savage mercenary for your Ogor Mawtribes armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. She lugs around a truly massive cannon, which is often reloaded during battle with chunks of hacked meat. Her fearsome reputation is well deserved, and her experience can sway the tides of battle in the favour of her Ogor companions.

Contents:
– 17 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 50mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide

title: Ogor Mawtribes: Butcher
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds a Butcher, a brutal Wizard for your Ogor Mawtribes armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Unlike most sorcerors, these twisted devotees of their hungry deity channel his power through acts of slaughter, growing their power with every quivering gobbet of bloody flesh they add to their magical cauldrons. They empower nearby units through their devotion, getting stuck in on the front lines along with the rest of the army. You'll find two different heads to customise this shaman.

Contents:
– 9 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 50mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide

title: Ogor Mawtribes: Ironguts
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds 3 Ironguts – elite, aggressive bodyguards for your Ogor Mawtribes armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Equipped with cruel two-handed weapons and thick armour, they are prepared to get stuck in and ensure your leaders are safe on the front lines.

This highly customisable kit includes a variety of build options:
– 1 blade and cleaver for the Champion
– 1 set of trophy tusks for the Champion
– 7 heads
– 1 double-handed hammer
– 2 double-handed blades
– 1 optional shoulder fur trim

Contents:
– 59 plastic components
– 3 Citadel 40mm Round Bases
– 1 construction guide

title: Regiment of Renown: Okar's Torrbad
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds Okar's Torrbad – a powerful Regiment of Renown for your Gloomspite Gitz, Kruleboyz, Ironjawz, and Sons of Behemat armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. The individual units can also be used in your Ogor Mawtribes army, and you'll save money compared to buying them individually. With two massive miniatures, they are ideal for adding incredibly strong and hard-to-kill beasts to your army – allowing you to dominate the front lines.

This boxed set builds 2 multipart plastic Ogor Mawtribes miniatures:
– 1 Huskard on Stonehorn
– 1 Thundertusk Beastriders

Contents:
– 234 plastic components
– 2 Citadel 120mm by 92mm Oval Bases
– 1 construction guide

title: Ogor Mawtribes: Cleavers/Gutseers
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds 3 Cleavers, bloated mage-hunting specialists for your Ogor Mawtribes armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Equipped with paired melee weapons, they hunt down Wizards and Priests to harvest their prized flesh for the Butchers.

This customisable kit includes some build options. The first miniature can optionally be assembled as a Champion with a unique head option, armed with a hatchet and holding a large pot. The second miniature has 2 head options and can be assembled holding either a meat hook or a knife in its left hand. The third miniature has 2 head options and can be built with a hammer or a hatchet in its right hand.

This unit can alternatively be built as Gutseers, magically attuned devotees of the Gulping God.

Contents:
– 66 plastic components
– 3 Citadel 40mm Round Bases
– 1 construction guide

title: Hunters with Sabrefangs
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds 3 Hunters and 2 Sabrefangs, stalking predators and their masters for your Ogor Mawtribes armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Armed with large crossbows and skinning blades, these sharpshooters are surrounded by sorcerous storms of frost, concealing their position until they're ready to strike. This makes them ideal disruption units, causing your opponent to adapt to their presence. You'll find 2 head options and an optional vulture for the champion, and 5 different head options for the Hunters.

Contents:
– 66 plastic components
– 3 Citadel 40mm Round Bases
– 2 Citadel 60mm by 35.5mm Oval Bases
– 1 construction guide

title: Maulbeast Raiders/Cavalry
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds 2 Maulbeast Raiders, a fast-moving harassment unit for your Ogor Mawtribes armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. These skilled hunters use crossbows to take down their prey, but aren't afraid to get up close and personal, where their vicious mounts can gore and tear chunks out of the enemy with their fangs.

This customisable kit includes a variety of interchangeable parts, 1 weapon-at-rest arm, 1 Blood Vulture, and 1 unique head option to build an optional Champion.

Interchangeable parts:
– 2 Maulbeast horns
– 2 Maulbeast faces
– 2 Ogor leg sets
– 2 back banners
– 2 saddle horns

This kit can alternatively be built as Maulbeast Cavalry, a more heavily armoured dedicated melee unit.

Contents:
– 81 plastic components
– 2 Citadel 90mm by 52.5mm Oval Bases
– 1 construction guide

title: Redd the Maw – High Slaughtermaster
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds Redd the Maw, riding atop a carriage holding a massive cauldron, as well as a trio of warriors. Redd the Maw is a zealous leader and powerful wizard for your Ogor Mawtribes armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. This potent unit offers boons to nearby ogors, exhorting them to fight all the harder in its inspiring presence. His acolyte bodyguards are ready to lay their lives down for the High Slaughtermaster, allowing Redd the Maw to get up in the front lines where his presence makes the biggest impact. This stunning diorama-like miniature is the perfect capstone to your Ogor Mawtribes collection.

Contents:
– 62 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 160mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide

title: Morga the Mighty – Overtyrant / Tyrant on Glutthorn
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds Morga the Mighty, a legendary leader for your Ogor Mawtribes armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. An experienced and grizzled warrior, Morga leads by example. She embraces the wild heart of her race, tearing chunks out of her foes and swallowing them whole. Her glutthorn mount, Grutta, adds to her hitting power in melee, making her an ideal leader to get stuck in on the front lines.

This kit can alternatively be built as a Tyrant on Glutthorn.

Contents:
– 56 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 120mm by 92mm Oval Base
– 1 construction guide

title: Chinese Pokémon Exclusive Dream Drawing Vol.3 Eeveelution Figure Set Blind Box
body:
Listing is for 1 Pack.  

Discover a special collectible release dedicated to Eevee and all of its Evolutions! The Pokémon TCG Dream Finishing Touch – Eevee & Evolutions Figurine Set combines collectible cards with beautifully detailed figures inspired by official Pokémon card artwork.

Each sealed blind box contains 1 random Eevee or Eeveelution figure together with a corresponding Pokémon card. You will also receive 1 Terastal Gathering Booster Pack, combining a display collectible with the excitement of opening Pokémon TCG cards.

The collection features 9 standard designs – Eevee, Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon, Espeon, Umbreon, Leafeon, Glaceon and Sylveon. Lucky collectors can also find 1 rare hidden Sleeping Eevee variant, which comes with a matching Special Illustration holographic card. The production ratio of regular figures to the hidden version is 80:1.

Each box contains:

  • 1× random Pokémon figure

title: CHINESE Pokemon 30th Anniversary Celebration First Partner Vol. 3
body:
The Simplified Chinese Pokémon 30th Anniversary First Partner Set Vol. 3 is the latest entry in this commemorative series, released in August 2026. This volume continues the tradition of featuring high-quality "Special Illustration" foil promo cards that highlight the deep bond between trainers and their starter Pokémon.

Like the previous volumes, this is a blind-box style release where the contents are randomized. When you place the three starter cards from the same region side-by-side, they form a connected, panoramic-style illustration.

Key Contents:

  • 1 Random Special Illustration Foil Promo Card: One of nine possible designs featuring starter Pokémon from the Hoenn, Kalos, and Paldea regions:

    • Hoenn: Treecko, Torchic, Mudkip

    • Kalos: Chespin, Fennekin, Froakie

    • Paldea: Sprigatito, Fuecoco, Quaxly

  • 1 Acrylic Magnetic Display Frame: A premium frame designed to protect and display your card; these frames are modular and can be connected horizontally with frames from other volumes to create a larger display.

  • 1 "Stellar Crystal" (or "Chasing Glory Together") Booster Pack: A 5-card expansion pack included to further your collection.

title: Digimon Timeless Bonds (BT-26) Booster Pack
body:
Relive the Emotional Climax of DIGIMON STORY TIME STRANGER! Faithfully recreates the powerful finale of Digimon Story Time Stranger, the hit game released last year! A wide lineup of characters from the game are included. Following BT-24/BT-25, cards with the [TS] trait allow players to recreate the story of the game within the Digimon Card Game!
Olympus XII Appear as Dual Cards! The Olympus XII Digimon, who played key roles in the game, now arrive as Dual Cards! Recreate their dramatic moments from the story while unleashing Arts Digivolve, demonstrating overwhelming power!
Those Formidable Foes from the Final Stages of the Story Appear! The powerful Giant Slayer and Chronomon: Destroy Mode, which stood in the way during the story’s climax, make their debut in the Digimon Card Game! Run rampant with effects that faithfully recreate the events of the game!
More Cards from Digimon Beat Break and Digimon Data Squad! Following ST-23/ST-24 and BT-25, this set includes cards from the currently airing Digimon Beat Break as well as Digimon Data Squad, which celebrates its 20th anniversary! The [Glowing Dawn] and [DATS] decks receive even further enhancements!

body:
Chihiro's cursed past sends him down a quest of bloody vengeance!

Chihiro Rokuhira’s father, Kunishige, is the most famous swordsmith in the land. Thanks to his six enchanted blades, the war that has been gripping the nation ends, and peaceful days follow. After the war, he retrieves all six blades and hides them in the cellar of his workshop—but sorcerers raid his home and leave Kunishige dead in front of Chihiro. Many years later, Chihiro wields Kunishige’s seventh and final enchanted blade on a mission to retrieve the stolen swords!

Chihiro takes Iori to the Kyoto Bloodshed Hotel to hide her from the Hishaku. There, Iori must decide whether she wants to regain her memories of her father or continue leading a blissfully ignorant existence. But when the hotel is turned into a sea of blood by one of the Hishaku, the innocent girl’s decision is made for her!

body: We think this little guy might be your new favorite thing. While you can splat this frog, do you really want to? title: Secret Lair Drop: Secret Lair x Stardew Valley: Welcome to Stardew Valley - Non-Foil Edition
body:
Product packaging may vary.
Welcome to Stardew Valley, where every day asks for something different. Plant the parsnips. Check the mail. Bring someone a gift you’re pretty sure they’ll like. Wander into town with dirt on your boots and come home with a recipe, a new friend, or a problem that somehow involves a wizard. Before long, the farm is more than a place to make a living. It’s a rhythm, a refuge, and occasionally the source of extremely suspicious noises after dark.
Illustrated by ConcernedApe in a style that feels pulled straight from the valley itself, these cards turn farming, foraging, friendship, and small-town mystery into Magic. The new-to-Magic design, Stardew Valley, follows that same daily rhythm: a little help becomes food, a thoughtful offering draws you deeper into the day, and something of your own may find its way across the table. Around here, a good harvest matters—but knowing what to give, when to give it, and who might appreciate it is part of the work too.

Yes, this special issue of Flash features Superman villains going up against the Fastest Man Alive! And maybe even a Battlemech or two. Do all of them get punched really fast? title: Warriors of Chaos - Chaos Warriors
body:
The Anvil AND the Hammer

This multipart plastic kit builds 16 Chaos Warriors, heavy infantry for your Warriors of Chaos armies in games of Warhammer: The Old World. They can be assembled as 1 large unit, or two smaller units of 8, each with a full command section. Fully encased in heavy armour and tall shields, they are incredibly hard to kill. They march implacably across the field of battle, putting an assortment of heavy hand weapons to murderous use when they reach the foe's front lines.

The miniatures in this box are easy to customise. There are 16 heads, 32 shoulder pads, 16 shields, and 14 hand weapons to choose from, which are all interchangeable across the Chaos Warriors. You'll also find components for 2 champions, musicians, and standard bearers if you choose to build them.

Contents:
– 206 plastic components
– 16 Citadel 30mm Square Bases
– 1 construction guide

title: Warriors of Chaos - Chaos Knights
body:
This multipart plastic kit builds 8 Chaos Knights, heavy cavalry for your Warriors of Chaos armies in games of Warhammer: The Old World. They can be assembled as 1 larger unit, or 2 smaller units of 4, each with a full command section. These fast, resilient, and hard-hitting warriors will form a powerful core around which the rest of your army can be built.

The miniatures in this box are easy to customise. There are 24 heads, 16 shoulder pads, 6 shields, and 8 lances, which are interchangeable across the Chaos Knights. You'll also find components for 2 champions, musicians, and standard bearers if you choose to build them.

Contents:
– 128 plastic components
– 8 Citadel 30mm by 60mm Rectangle Bases
– 1 Chaos Knights and Champion Transfer Sheet
– 1 construction guide

The Chaos Knights and Champion Transfer Sheet features 146 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include eight-pointed stars, emblems, and dark runes to decorate your banners.

title: Warriors of Chaos: Lord/Sorcerer on Chaos Dragon
body:
A Twin-headed Terror From the Skies

This multipart plastic kit builds 1 Lord on Chaos Dragon and 1 Chaos Sorcerer on foot for your Warriors of Chaos armies in games of Warhammer: The Old World. This powerful unit will wreak havoc on the battlefield, combining speed with an impressive capacity for destruction that's only enhanced by the rider. This large and imposing miniature, measuring 305mm from wingtip to wingtip and 280mm tall, will be the pride of your collection, looking just as impressive on your shelves as it does leading a mighty army.

Customise Your Kit

The Chaos Dragon's rider can be assembled as either a Chaos Lord or a Sorcerer Lord, with the other on foot. The Chaos Lord is clad in heavy plate armour, and equipped with a tall shield or axe in one hand, and a long polearm or sword in the other. They have 2 horned helmets to choose from. The Sorcerer Lord comes with 3 head options. The Chaos Dragon has 2 different styles of heads, 2 sets of interchangeable horns to customise their look, and 2 sets of saddles and accessories to choose from.

Contents:
– 101 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 100mm by 150mm Rectangle Base
– 1 Citadel 30mm by 30mm Square Base
– 1 construction guide

title: White Dwarf 527 (OOS)
body:
White Dwarf is the official Warhammer magazine, packed with amazing monthly content – including new rules and background, short stories, regular columns, special guests, and more.

Here’s what you can look forward to in the August issue:

WARHAMMER 40,000

Echoes Of Armageddon
Armageddon is at war once again and the comms traffic sounds bleak. Unless you’re Orks, in which case, let’s be ’avin ya!

Designers’ Notes: Armageddon
Want a closer look at the miniatures in the launch box? Of course you do. Stunning photos of amazing models surrounded by commentary from the designers. Perfect.

Paint Splatter: Armageddon
For Sanguinius and... Ghazghkull? Get your Blood Angels and Goff Orks ready for war with these stage-by-stage painting guides.

A New Era Of War
Our rules savants of the far future delve into some of the exciting changes in the new edition. For us, it’s all about terrain objectives!

Dark Millennia
It’s been 39 years since Warhammer 40,000 first translated out of the Warp and into our tiny little minds. Here’s a quick trip down memory lane.

Battle Report: First Contact
Two new games developers take the new models for a spin on the battlefield. Rules commentaries, cunning tactics, and some entertainingly unfortunate dice rolls ensue.

WARHAMMER AGE OF SIGMAR

A Tale Of Four Warlords
With bleary eyes and paint-spattered fingers, our warlords reach the end of their journey. We take a look at the fruits of their labours.

Secrets Of The Jade Abbey
Shhhhhh. It’s a secret. Okay, okay. Gather round. Closer. Closer. Not you, Nurgling. Closer... No! It’s still a secret!

A Lone Wanderer
Have you ever thought how much fun it would be to wander off into a Nurgle-infested abbey all on your own? You have? Well that’s fortunate. Enter here for a suite of solo quests.

OTHER ARTICLES

Voyage Of The Saltfyre: From Under Clawed Foot
Aye-aye, landlubbers! A Grey Seer and a Deathmaster have a cunning plan-trick. But it requires them taking to the high seas in this new short story. Part one-one of five-five.

Access Granted
Here you will find painting challenges and the latest Bunker news. Curated by Servitor 13.

Your Warhammer
Blood Angels, Orks, the Leaders and Heroes painting challenge, and a spotlight on Crossfire Gaming.

The White Dwarf Round-up
This time, painting metal, the Londaxi Maimer, and Ben’s face.

Bunker Bingo

title: AMX-014 Doven Wolf (Unicorn Ver.) Bandai HG Model Kit
body: The HGUC 1/144 Doven Wolf (Unicorn Ver.) by Bandai Hobby is a highly detailed model kit from the Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn series. This High-Grade (HG) kit features impressive articulation, allowing for a wide range of dynamic poses. Designed with accurate proportions and intricate mechanical details, this model captures the powerful presence of the Doven Wolf. It comes with a variety of accessories, including beam rifles, missile pods, and interchangeable hand parts. The kit also features color-separated plastic for an eye-catching finish, even without additional painting. With snap-fit assembly, no glue is required, making it ideal for both beginners and experienced builders. A great addition to any Gundam Unicorn collection, this kit brings the Doven Wolf to life with high-quality detailing and articulation.

title: ASW-G-XX Gundam Vidar Bandai MG Model Kit
body:
The Gundam Vidar from "Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans" joins Bandai's "Master Grade (MG)" model-kit lineup! Equipped with an updated Gundam Frame, this kit was made under the supervision of mecha designer Ippei Gyoubu! The updated Gundam Frame allows for an expanded range of motion in the shoulder joints; the Hunter Edges on its toes and heels can be deployed. The armor behind the knees and the verniers move in tandem with the motion of the legs; the handgun is equipped with an MG-original gimmick that evokes blowback movement. The rifle's magazine can be detached, and the Burst Saber comes with a blade part that reproduces the end shape when it's purged. You can also choose to build the cockpit with the Alaya-Vijnana Type-E either activated or deactivated. Order this incredible machine for your own collection today!

[16] 1:72 SV-51 Nora Type from "Macross Zero" — a 1/72 scale injection-plastic model kit from Hasegawa of the SV-51 variable fighter in fighter mode, tooled entirely new for this release.

The decals reproduce the red-purple machine with special markings flown by Nora. Parts are laid out to be built up unit by unit, with sharp engraving throughout for an aircraft-like finish. The canopy and lift fan cover can be built open or closed, the vector nozzles open and close, and the tail can be assembled in parked or in-flight configuration. Tanks, composite pods and anti-ship missiles for the underside of the main wing are included, and the completed aircraft is a little over 30cm long. The kit has 7 runners plus a small clear one for the canopy and other clear parts, for a total of over 150 parts, with fine detail all over and nicely printed decals.

Key Features

  • 1/72 scale injection plastic kit, all-new tooling
  • Over 150 parts across 7 runners plus a clear runner
  • Open or closed canopy and lift fan cover
  • Vector nozzles open and close
  • Parked or in-flight tail options
  • A little over 30cm long when assembled

What's Included

  • Underwing tanks
  • Composite pods
  • Anti-ship missiles
  • Decals

body:

Sun sets on the city of Arkham. Citizens hurry home in the growing twilight, eager to find safety behind locked doors. Arkham has always played host to strange occurrences, but this time, something is different. title: Legendary Arc-V Decks: Box Set
body:
The latest Legendary Decks set comes your way with THREE MORE complete, ready-to-play Decks styled after some of the most popular Decks to come out of Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V!
Legendary Arc-V Decks has the same structure as March’s Legendary Modern Decks 2026: 3 x 55-card Decks (each with a 40-card Main Deck and 15-card Extra Deck), with 1 Secret Rare and 6 Ultra Rares per Deck. Plus a bonus packet with a 56th card for each Deck, a Secret Rare copy of 1 of 6 cards from that Deck with a chance to upgrade to Starlight Rare!
And just like Legendary Modern Decks 2026, Legendary Arc-V Decks is loaded with multiples of the cards you need to play these Decks, and multiples of the popular “staple” cards that everyone wants for ANY Deck, these days.
Legendary Arc-V Decks has Decks based on “Odd-Eyes” (used by Yuya, from the Standard Dimension), “Lunalight” (used by Celina, from the Fusion Dimension), and “Speedroid” (used by Yugo, from the Synchro Dimension).
And each new Deck has a brand-new trick up its sleeve. Let’s take a look!
“Odd-Eyes” swings back into action with a new Link-3 “Odd-Eyes” Monster with 2500 ATK. It can destroy any 1 other card you control to draw a card, and if you destroyed a Pendulum Monster Card, you get an extra Pendulum Summon for your “Performapal,” “Magician,” and “Odd-Eyes” monsters! And for an encore, during your turn, it can negate any effect that your opponent activates by simply discarding a card!
“Lunalight” came in 2nd place at the World Championship 2025, so what do you give the Deck that has almost everything? Answer: More ways to set up for Fusion Summoning! You can Special Summon the Deck’s new Level 5 Beast-Warrior from your hand any time your “Lunalight” monster activates its effect, and if your opponent activated a card or effect that same turn, you can also grab a Polymerization from your Deck or Graveyard, so you’re all set to go! As a back-up feature, if this brand-new Lunalight monster is sent to the Graveyard by card effect, you can Special Summon another “Lunalight” monster from your Graveyard or face-up Extra Deck.
“Speedroid” is gunning for 1st place by accelerating its Synchro Summoning! Its brand-new Level 4 Tuner WIND monster can be Special Summoned from your hand by sending any “Speedroid” card from your Deck to the Graveyard. And if it’s sent from the field to the Graveyard, you can grab a “Speedroid” Spell/Trap from your Deck AND THEN, if you control a “Clear Wing” monster you can destroy any monster on the field!
With 3 ready-to-play Decks, brand-new cards, and another round of everyone’s favorite “staple” cards that go great in ANY Deck, Legendary Arc-V Decks has something for everyone, whether you’re a new, returning, or experienced Duelist!
Legendary Arc-V Decks contains 168 cards:
• 3 Secret Rares
• 18 Ultra Rares
• 144 Commons
• 3 bonus Secret Rares, with a chance to upgrade to Starlight Rare instead!

title: Berserk Vol. 30
body: Thanks to Lady Farnese's selfless sacrifice, Guts, the Black Swordsman, and the rest of his companions are free to carry on their journey aboard the ship of Farnese's brother, Magnifico — that is, if they're willing to leave Farnese behind. But having to choose between their mission and their loyalties might not be a problem for long if the Kushan emperor and his legion of monstrous minions have their way. With a host of Kushan forces descending on Vritannis, there might not be much left of Farnese's family — or any of the citizenry — to worry about!

title: Berserk Vol. 14
body:
The once unbeatable Band of the Hawk is smashed, and their former leader, Griffith, has made an unholy pact with the demon lords of the Godhand, sacrificing his former troops to resurrect his crippled body and ascend to stand in power beside these profane gods. The Invocation of Doom has unleashed a plague of unspeakable horrors upon the earth, and the first battle not only shatters the Hawks, but the hand of their champion, Guts, and the mind of their captain and Guts’ lover, Casca. And while time may heal some of Guts’ wounds, it will not heal his desire for vengeance. And his discovery of a gigantic, dragon-slaying sword might be just the ticket to deal out some king-sized payback!

Also included in this volume: "Berserk Prototype," the very first Berserk story, created during Kentaro Miura’s college days as his audition that sold the series!

title: Berserk Vol. 12
body: The Band of the Hawks’ rescue of their leader, Griffith, has brought them no ease. Broken beyond healing, a frail ghost of his former glory, Griffith is now more an object of pity than a man, and the Hawks, who’ve grimly hung together under duress and death during his absence, are now on the verge of splintering to the winds. But Griffith’s dreams and ambitions, built on the bodies of his troops and the countless enemies they have slain, have not gone unnoticed in the spirit realm, and though Griffith has nowhere to go as a man, he may yet have a future . . . a future borne on jet-black wings in the company of the demon lords of the Godhand!

title: Wingspan Pocket
body:
Wingspan Pocket distills the Wingspan experience down to a lighter, shorter, card-driven game that has each player activate a single row of cards on each of their turns. Wingspan Pocket is designed to be accessible to novice players yet also compelling for more experienced gamers. This is a standalone game in a small box, not an expansion (the birds in it are not compatible with Wingspan). Wingspan Pocket features birds from around the world.

title: Duel of Meloch
body:
Duel of Meloch is a standalone game that combines mechanisms from two existing games, Scythe and Expeditions, into a 45-minute head-to-head clash. One player uses Scythe rules and components (including a new faction and player mat); the other player uses Expedition rules and components (including a new mech, character, and companion). As long as you know one of those games and your opponent knows the other, you can play Duel of Meloch, and you don’t need anything other than Duel of Meloch to play this game.

You can even play Scythe vs Scythe or Expeditions vs Expeditions duels if you own either of those games (or even just Invaders from Afar or Gears of Corruption, respectively).

The duel takes place in a tight space on a new double-sided map—only 10 locations and 2 lakes—in a race to 4 stars on a new double-sided Triumph Track, so every turn is crucial. The devious Meloch keeps the game close by giving a small boost to your opponent every time you place a star.

All existing Scythe factions, player mats, encounter cards, and factory cards are compatible with Duel of Meloch, as are all existing Expeditions mechs, characters, companions, and discovery cards (items, meteorites, and half of the quests). Likewise, the components in Duel of Meloch are compatible with Scythe and Expeditions: For Scythe, 3 new Factory cards, 6 new encounter cards, a completely new set of 60 combat cards; for Expeditions, 30 new discovery cards (items, quests, and meteorites).

Components

Scythe

  • 1 rule summary guide
  • 20 resource tokens
  • 3 Factory cards
  • 60 combat cards (new design)
  • 6 encounter cards
  • 5 miniatures
  • 31 wooden tokens
  • 1 faction mat
  • 1 player mat
  • 1 Power Dial
  • 1 alliance token and 1 home base tile (these are not used in Duel of Meloch)

Expeditions

  • 1 rule summary guide
  • 1 Power Dial
  • 12 corruption tokens
  • 15 workers
  • 30 discovery cards
  • 3 starting cards
  • 1 mech miniature & 1 base snap
  • 8 wooden tokens
  • 1 mech mat

Global

  • 1 double-sided rubber playmat
  • 20 cardboard coins
  • 9 map tokens
  • 1 double-sided Triumph Track
  • 10 Meloch cards
  • 1 Tournament of Meloch sheet
  • 1 game box (310 x 192 x 73mm)
  • 1 rulebook and 1 appendix

Solo

  • 1 progress track tile
  • 1 Triumph Track overlay tile
  • 20 Automa cards
  • 6 phase cards
  • 4 double-sided player aid cards
  • 1 rulebook

title: Marvel Champions: The Card Game - Luke Cage Hero Pack
body:
While wrongly imprisoned, Luke Cage was subjected to an experimental treatment that gave him superhuman strength and impenetrable skin. With his newfound powers, he took to the streets as a hero-for-hire, working side-by-side with his friends to protect their city from the criminals vying to control it. Now, Luke is powering his way into your games of Marvel Champions: The Card Game! 

With his unbreakable skin allowing him to stack any number of tough status cards, Luke Cage is a strong and sturdy hero that can power his way through the gnarliest of fights. In this hero pack, you’ll find Luke Cage, his fifteen signature cards, and a full assortment of Leadership cards inviting you to lead your allies into battle. Anyone looking to take down the Kingpin’s criminal underworld will want to add the Luke Cage Hero Pack to their collection! This expansion comes with a 40-card pre-built deck, allowing you to start playing from the moment you open the box.

  • ICONIC MARVEL DEFENDER: Play as Luke Cage, the unbreakable hero-for-hire with superhuman strength and resilience.

body:
🔥 Nashville Hot... but make it chocolate. That's right—we took one look at a fried chicken leg and thought, "You know what this needs? Belgian milk chocolate." 😆 Meet the Cocoa Cluck Nashville Hot Chocolate Chicken Leg, the novelty candy that's guaranteed to stop customers in their tracks.

This wildly fun treat features a creamy vanilla cayenne crème filling, wrapped in premium Belgian milk chocolate and coated in a crispy cornflake crunch for the ultimate sweet-and-heat experience. It looks like a piece of fried chicken, tastes absolutely nothing like one, and somehow that's exactly what makes it awesome.

title: Cocoa Cluck Chocolate "Chicken" Leg Maple Waffle - 1.9oz Box (SNG12)
body:
🐔 Winner, winner... chocolate dinner! If you've ever wanted to eat a chicken leg for dessert, your moment has arrived. The Cocoa Cluck Maple Waffle Chocolate Chicken Leg looks like it belongs at Sunday brunch, but one bite reveals it's all sweet, no savory!

This hilarious novelty treat features a creamy maple crème filling coated in rich milk chocolate and rolled in crispy waffle cone crunch for the ultimate sweet-and-crunchy combo. It doesn't taste like chicken (thankfully), but it does taste like breakfast and dessert teamed up for the greatest crossover since peanut butter met chocolate. 🧇🍫

title: Are We Compatible? - A Romantic Relationship Game
body: How compatible are you really? Are We Compatible? by Relatable is the ultimate relationship card game for couples who love to laugh, connect, and dive deeper. Whether you're newly dating or long-time partners, this psychology-inspired game transforms the viral compatibility test into a fun, meaningful experience you’ll want to revisit again and again. Designed for ages 18+. 2+ Players

title: Shut The Box
body: One of Our Most Energizing Table Games: includes 2 dice, 1 wooden box, 1 score pad, and instructions. Strengthen your skills, spend time with loved ones, and compete to be the champion of game night! Player one starts by rolling the dice and flipping down the tiles to match the dice numbers or their total. Keep rolling and flipping until no match is possible. Then total up your remaining tiles and record your score. Reset the box for the next player. Lowest score wins! Recommended for ages 8+ years.

title: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe
body: Classic fun meets modern strategy! Ultimate Tic Tac Toe™ by Relatable takes the simple game you love and levels it up with a new twist and two exciting ways to play. Whether you're just learning or ready to master the advanced version, this game is packed with hours of fun for kids and adults alike.

title: Kollide - The Magnetic Attraction Strategy Game
body: Don't let the magnets Kollide! Kollide is the game of magnetic attraction — you'll have to place your magnets carefully within the battlefield without letting them link up! As the tension builds, each move becomes more critical. Test the limits of nature with Kollide! This magnet game is created in partnership with TikTok's very own @Games4Two! Take it from the experts, this is one board game you'll turn to for endless laughter, connection, and joy. 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭'𝐬 𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞: The box includes 1 rope, 20 magnets, carrying bag and instructions. Ages 8+

title: Color Stack Challenge
body: Ready to put your brain to the test? Color Stack Challenge™ by Relatable is a fast-paced color-matching puzzle game that’s as fun as it is challenging. Whether you’re a solo solver or a competitive duo, this game brings logic, speed, and color chaos to your next game night. Players race to match their stack of rings to the challenge card—one move at a time, and only by following the color logic. It’s a perfect blend of brain teaser and speed puzzle, ideal for kids, teens, adults, and families who love smart games with quick rounds.

Billions of lives depend on an impossible victory against a team of the vilest, most gruesome demons in the entire underworld!

title: Catwoman #90
body: GAME OVER! Selina Kyle has made many enemies in her life, but none who hate her with quite the same vitriol as Black Mask and Katarina Belov. With the stage set for an unforgettable night of torture and violence aimed at Selina and those closest to her, there's only one question left to ask — when the curtains go up on the grand finale, who will live and who will die? One thing's for certain — not everyone is making it out alive.

title: The Infinite and the Divine (HB) (OOS)
body:
THE STORY
Before the being called the Emperor revealed Himself, before the rise of the aeldari, before the necrontyr traded their flesh for immortal metal, the world was born in violence.

Even when they inhabited bodies of flesh, Trazyn the Infinite and Orikan the Diviner were polar opposites. Trazyn, a collector of historical oddities, presides over a gallery full of the most dangerous artefacts – and people – of the galactic past. Orikan, a chronomancer without peer, draws zodiacs that predict and manipulate the future. But when an artefact emerges that may hold the key to the necrons’ next evolution, these two obsessives enter a multi-millennia game of cat and mouse that ends civilisations, reshapes timelines, and changes both forever. As riddles unwind and ancient secrets are revealed, the question remains: will their feud save the necron race or destroy it?

Written by Robert Rath.

title: 2025 Topps Chrome Football Mega Box
body:
Each Box contains 7 Rookies, 3 Base Refractors, 1 Rookie Refractor, 6 Base or Rookie X-Fractor Parallels, 3 Base or Rookie Hot Pink X-Fractor Parallels, 1 Base or Rookie Lime Green X-Fractor, 1 Base or Rookie Pulsar Parallel, 1 Insert X-Fractor Parallel, and 4 Insert Cards, on average!

The NFL is back with Topps-and it starts here. Topps Chrome returns to the NFL.

Collectors can chase the league in Chrome, where premium design meets the thrill of the rip. This isn't just a comeback-it's the new home of NFL collecting. 2025 Topps Chrome Football introduces game-changing hits that redefine what football cards can be:

Rookie PREM1ERE Patch Autographs:

Real game. Real moment. These patches were worn by players the first time they suited up for an official regular-season NFL game, turning a rookie card into a true milestone. The kind of pull that becomes the centerpiece of a collection.

Topps Chrome Autographs:

Where the game's biggest names meet iconic Chrome shine. Featuring a dynamic mix of rookies, superstars, and legends, these coveted autographs are amplified by the full Chrome rainbow-including ultra-rare, low-numbered parallels built for the ultimate chase. Look for signatures from Tom Brady and Barry Sanders, current stars like Josh Allen and Jahmyr Gibbs, and rising talent such as Jaxson Dart and Tetairoa McMillan.

Fan-favorite inserts like Helix, Ultra Violet, Radiating Rookies, and Fanatical also return to the spotlight, joined by bold new football debuts like Kaiju and Game Genies.

Every pack brings a new look, a new energy, and a new shot at hitting something unforgettable.

2025 Topps Chrome Football isn't just back. It's built for the next era of the Hobby.

title: Batman: The Animated Series - Enemies of Gotham City
body:
In Enemies of Gotham City, play as infamous villains like The Joker, Poison Ivy, and Two Face. 
Fight to make some cash, thwart Batman, and become the most feared villain in Gotham City. To do this, you’ll have to plan out your moves and strategize, but you must also be adaptable, Gotham City is in chaos, and your plans may not always go as intended!
Wrestle for control of Gotham’s districts with rival villains and out-think your opponents by using your power and weapons. Watch out for Batman and his allies who are looking to bring peace to Gotham City and send you to Arkham Asylum.
Will you become the most infamous villain of them all, or are you just another two-bit crook?
Core set Includes: 165 PLAYABLE CARDS, 22 PLASTIC FIGURES, 100 TOKENS, 60 FIRE TOPPERS, 12 ICE TOPPERS, 12 GREEN HOUSE TOPPERS, 1 CUBE TOWER, 13 BOARDS, 1GAMEBOARD, 150 WOODEN CUBES, 6 WOODEN TRACKERS, 6 WOODEN HENCHMEN, 24 BUILDING MINIATURES, 6 COLORED STANDEE RINGS, 1 METAL COIN, and 1 RULEBOOK.

title: DC Legendary - Deck Building Game Core Set
body:
Legendary: DC Deck-Building Game is a standalone deck-building game that brings the DC Universe into the Legendary family. Players assume the roles of DC superheroes working cooperatively to thwart the schemes of a Mastermind villain and their associated threats.

Each game features a randomly selected Mastermind who pursues a unique evil Scheme, creating a distinct challenge for players. Throughout the game, players build their decks by recruiting Heroes and acquiring powerful cards to strengthen their capabilities. Sidekick cards provide crucial support in defeating Villains and completing objectives that emerge during play.

The game incorporates a Hope and Fear Tracker that measures the overall state of the conflict. As the tracker shifts, it influences when and how players can activate special abilities tied to their Heroes, requiring strategic timing and decision-making to overcome increasingly difficult threats.

The core set includes a diverse array of characters from the DC Universe, each represented through original artwork. These Heroes, Villains, Masterminds, and various card types provide multiple paths to victory and strategic variety across different games.

Players win by working together to defeat the Mastermind's Scheme before either the Mastermind achieves their objectives or the game state becomes unwinnable. Success requires careful deck management, tactical card play, and coordinated use of each Hero's unique abilities.

Ages: 14+
Players: 1-4
Game Length: 30-60 minutes

title: Root: The Homeland Expansion
body:
Rediscover the Woodland with three brand-new factions and two new maps for Root!

  • Lilypad Diaspora - Scattered long ago and suppressed ever since, the Lilypad Diaspora now hopes to call the Woodland home. While they work to integrate peacefully, peace is rare in the midst of civil war. As they train their warriors, they must ensure that their desire for safety does not tip into outright aggression. With weapons at the ready, a simple misunderstanding between the Diaspora and the Woodland can flare into vicious reprisals, hardening the Diaspora's militancy and spreading resentment against their cause.

  • Twilight Council - Sickened by the enduring conflict, the Twilight Council hosts assemblies to end the war, bringing together all the Woodland from the lowliest mouse-in-a-sack to the mightiest hawk with a royal claim. The assemblies emphasize political connections over pure numbers of warriors, pushing the factions away from bloody battle and toward heated debate. As the Council progresses in their mission, they can declare edicts to change how the assemblies work, manipulating their enemies' incentives and actions.

  • Knaves of the Deepwood - Nobody really knows how the Knaves of the Deepwood got together, but the myths are many. From the treeline these miscreants and ne'er-do-wells sally forth, raiding barracks and baggage trains and making off with warriors in tow as hostages. Why? For ransom, that's why. Some say they give the proceeds to the needy. Some say they spend it lavishly. Either way, their celebrations ring out through the night, the music swelling from the forest depths where few dare to go.


Ages: 10+
Players: 2-5
Game Length: 60-90 minutes

title: Kotobukiya MEGAMANX - ROCKMANX - Iris X4 Ver. Model Kit
body:
Incredibly popular for their fast-paced action and deep storytelling, the Mega Man X series became a core brand within the franchise.
The young Repliforce officer and sister of Colonel, Iris, finally joins the lineup as a plastic model kit!

Thanks to the technology of CAD engineering, the character’s proportions are faithfully recreated while maintaining an impressive range of articulation that allows users to recreate poses from the games!
With three interchangeable faces and a wide variety of hand parts, Iris can be displayed in many unforgettable scenes from the game.

Model Specifications:
・Includes three interchangeable face parts.
・Her voluminous hair consists of three articulated sections—base, middle, and ends—connected with swivel and ball joints for flexible movement to suit various expressions.
・The base and internal joints of the hair use an extendable ball-joint system for enhanced articulation.
・The hat is removable and a dedicated cover is included to display Iris without her hat.
・Includes five interchangeable hand parts.
・The skirt is made up of five separate sections, each independently movable to allow dynamic posing without hindering leg articulation.
・The kit is made of multi-colored plastic and contains pre-painted parts, making it easy for users of all levels to build Iris as she appears in the game.
・The packaging includes a specially drawn illustration by Mega Man X series character designer Keisuke Mizuno.

Included Items:
・Three Interchangeable Face Parts (Default, Looking Right/Smiling, Looking Left/Troubled)
・Five Interchangeable Hand Parts (Closed, Open A, Open B, Support, Weapon Holding)

title: Monopoly Deal: The Grinch
body:
THE GRINCH MONOPOLY DEAL GAME: Steal Christmas to win in this officially licensed Monopoly Deal: How the Grinch Stole Christmas! Edition game! With iconic characters, objects, and art from the Dr. Seuss holiday classic

body: Bring home Tails, the beloved two-tailed fox from the Sonic the Hedgehog™ universe! This soft and cuddly plush features Tails’ signature yellow-and-white coloring, pointed ears, and distinctive twin tails. Its small, portable size makes it perfect for play, collecting, displaying, or taking along on adventures. A fun gift for Sonic fans and plush collectors alike.

title: Yahtzee On The Rocks
body: Shake up your night with the Yahtzee On the Rocks game! It's the Yahtzee game with a grown-up twist. In this hydration-optional party game for ages 21+, players take turns drawing coaster cards with solo, head-to-head, and group challenges. On your turn, complete the dice challenge on the card. If you win, keep that card. After 5 quick rounds, the player with the most cards wins! Optional rule: If you lose a challenge, you may take a sip from a beverage of your choice, but you don’t have to! Perfect for game nights, this edition is an exciting twist on the Yahtzee game, with a variety of fun, fast, funny challenges. Whether you're looking for adult party games or group games, it's an ideal choice. Travel games and dice games for adults also make great gifts for college students, family, friends, and Yahtzee fans ages 21+.

title: It's Not That Deep
body:
It’s Not That Deep is the party game where hot takes, random challenges and personal sharing collide.

Ages

14 and Up

Players

2 to 6

  • PARTY GAME FUN – It’s Not That Deep combines hot takes, rapid-fire choices, hilarious challenges, and personal sharing into one wildly entertaining social party game experience. It's the game where casual vibing is encouraged and oversharing is optional.


  • FOUR EXPERIENCES IN ONE – Featuring Smash or Pass, Energy Checks, Spiral Lite, and Mirror Mirror, every round delivers a different style of gameplay that keeps the energy fresh and unpredictable.


  • PERFECT FOR GAME NIGHT – Designed for friends, roommates, couples, college groups, parties, vacations, and late-night hangouts where everyone is ready to laugh, react, and debate.

title: Godzilla Jr & Destoroyah Evolution Set "Godzilla", TAMASHII NATIONS S.H.MonsterArts
body:
From "Godzilla vs. Destoroyah", "Godzilla Jr.", "Juvenile Destoroyah", "Aggregate Destoroyah" and "Flying Destoroyah " are now available as a set by S.H.MonsterArts.

The prototypes of Godzilla Junior and Destoroyah are based on the original models sculpted by Yuji Sakai. The "Aggregate Destoroyah" and "Flying Destoroyah" were sculpted by Hiroshi Sagae and Taichi Yamada, respectively, using the original prototypes sculpted and produced by Shinichi Wakasa. The suit from 1995 has been thoroughly reproduced with reference to a number of materials.

The coloring of "Godzilla Jr." is based on various still photos from that time and reproduced the coloring of the night scene in the movie. The "Juvenile Destoroyah", "Aggregate Destoroyah" and "Flying Destoroyah" are painted in "night color" and "dust color", which are based on the battle scenes.

“Godzilla Jr." has a wide range of poses. In addition, the joints of "Aggregate Destoroyah" and "Flying Destoroyah" are movable, allowing you to enjoy the action poses in the movie. In addition, "Aggregate Destoroyah" can be replaced with an extended mouth!

*S.H.MonsterArts DESTOROYAH PERFECT FORM TOKYO WATERFRONT CITY DECISIVE BATTLE Ver. and S.H.MonsterArts GODZILLA [1995] 70th Anniversary Special Ver. sold separately

Set Contents:

  • Godzilla Junior Main Body
  • Juvenile Destoroyah
  • Aggregate Destoroyah
  • Flying Destoroyah
  • Aggregate Destoroyah head replacement parts
  • Special pedestal

S.H.MonsterArts are an action figure series featuring monsters, using the movable action figure technology cultivated by S.H.Figuarts. This is S.H.MonsterArts.

This is a Premium Bandai TAMASHII Web Shop Exclusive item in Japan that is being distributed as a limited release item globally for international markets including North America.

title: Scrunchems Surprise Box - 6 Compartment Sensory Squishy Toy
body:
6 surprises. Endless squish fun. A built-in mystery-box format that drives repeat purchases and word-of-mouth on its own. The Scrunchems Surprise Box brings the mystery-box trend into the sensory squishy category — six tear-away compartments, each hiding a unique squishy toy inside. From soft foam characters to jelly-filled and color-changing squishies, every reveal delivers a different texture and feel, giving customers a reason to keep coming back for more. The surprise-reveal format is a proven merchandising tool: it turns a routine toy purchase into an unboxing experience, which drives strong impulse buys at checkout counters and creates natural social/TikTok content for your customers to share. It also works well as a gift-bag filler, party favor, or standalone shelf item for toy stores, gift shops, and sensory-focused retailers.

Assorted styles inside may include: Sugar Marble Ball (2"), Mini Sugar Cube (1.4"), Foam-filled Bear (2.8"), Sugar Diddy Cat (1.8"), Happy Little Squish Ball (2"), Mini Color Change Ball (2").

title: Marvel Legends Series: X-MEN '97 Cyclops Premium Roleplay Visor
body:
Hasbro Marvel Legends proudly presents this 1:1 scale reproduction of Cyclops' Ruby Quartz Visor from Marvel Studios' X-Men '97 Animated Series!

Roleplay visor with premium design and deco features the character's signature yellow and red ruby quartz look. Marvel roleplay set includes a support piece for display and colored lens insert and is great for exhibiting in fans' collections. For fans ages 14 and up this Cyclops Visor can also be worn with a Cyclops Halloween costume or Marvel cosplay with spring loaded ear pieces and swapable nose pieces to ensure a proper fit.

Imagine leading the X-Men in a high-stakes battle for survival! Bring animation-inspired scenes to life with Marvel Legends action figures, roleplay gear, collectibles and gifts. (Each sold separately. Subject to availability.)

Features:

  • MARVEL STUDIOS' X-MEN '97: This premium Cyclops visor is inspired by the mutant leader's appearance in Marvel Studios' X-Men '97 animated series
  • LIGHT-UP EFFECT: Push button activates LED light that illuminates the clear tinted lens to simulate Cyclop's optic blast firing through the ruby quartz (visor requires 2 AAA batteries, not included); double tap to decrease the beam width
  • OFFICIALLY LICENSED MARVEL ROLEPLAY ITEM: Hasbro Marvel Legends visor features premium design with detailed sculpt and materials, making it a great gift for Marvel fans and collectors
  • PUSH BUTTON TO ACTIVATE: Imagine activating Cyclops' optic blast with simple push on the side dial and adjusting its intensity. LED lights time out after 2 minutes
  • 1:1 SCALE: This 1:1 scale visor is one-size fits most
  • CYCLOPS ROLEPLAY VISOR: Makes a great addition to an authentic Marvel Studios X-Men ’97 costume for adults, cosplay outfit, or even a Cyclops Halloween costume!
  • FOR WEAR OR DISPLAY: Spring-loaded ear pieces and swapable nose piece help ensure a proper fit. For desk or shelf display, the visor includes removable support and colored lens insert

Includes Visor and 3 pieces

  • Age 14+
  • X2 1.5v AAA ALKALINE BATTERIES REQUIRED. Not included.
  • WARNING: This toy produces flashes that may trigger epilepsy in sensitised individuals.
  • Colors, packaging, accessories, and decorations may vary and are subject to change.

body: The bewildered and near-mad Casca, former captain of the Band of the Hawk — and former lover of Guts, the Black Swordsman — has been adopted by Midland’s pagan cults as a witch, due to her demonic Mark of Sacrifice. But the Holy Iron Chain Knights campaign to rid the kingdom of heretics by any means necessary puts Casca in mortal danger, and Guts is having none of it, But all parties involved may end up with more than they bargained for as demonic spirits, drawn to Casca’s brand, begin to possess the heretics and unleash the forces of hell. title: Berserk Vol. 18
body: Hell has broken loose in the kingdom of Midland. On the death of Midland's king comes invasion, demonic forces seem to be on the rise, underground pagan cults are running wild, and the church is busily rounding up and teaching heretics the errors of their ways. While, Guts is busy testing out his newly repaired sword on the invaders, his former captain and lover, Casca, her mind wrecked by her unholy tryst with the demon lord, has fallen in with a rough crowd who don't exactly wish her well. But she, like Guts, is marked with the Brand of Sacrifice, and her abusers may soon find themselves face-to-face with the unholy abominations that are inexorably drawn to the Brand!
