title: Who Says? Friends
body:
We were on a break! You know who said it? You earn a point. That's the heart of the quote-guessing party game Who Says? Friends. Players earn points by identifying who said each quote from a popular franchise. Recognize real quotes and spot fake ones. Gain bonus points for knowing which season and episode the quote came from.

  • ICONIC FRIENDS QUOTES: Test your knowledge of the hit TV show Friends by guessing which character said each memorable line.
  • REAL OR FAKE CHALLENGE: Spot authentic quotes and identify cleverly crafted fakes for an extra layer of fun and difficulty.
  • EARN BONUS POINTS: Go beyond basic trivia by naming the correct season and episode for even more competitive gameplay.
  • FAST & SOCIAL PARTY GAME: Easy-to-learn rules and quick rounds make it perfect for game nights, parties, and Friends fan gatherings.
  • PERFECT FOR FANS & GIFTING: A must-have for Friends enthusiasts, trivia lovers, and anyone looking for a fun, nostalgic group game.

Contents:

100 quote cards, 32 charcter cards, 1 rule sheet

title: Tea Garden: Puerh Expansion
body:
The Puerh expansion transforms your Tea Garden experience with the introduction of the Court of Nobles. With two new main actions plus dynamic Imperial Decrees, every decision becomes deeper, more tactical, and more rewarding. Command the Court Send your new Courtier meeples to the grand halls of the Court. Gain immediate bonuses and compete for influence—because holding the majority at the end of each round earns valuable victory points. Shape the Puerh Market. 

Strategic planners will thrive in the all-new Puerh Market. Connect pieces to build combinations, unlocking bonuses not only from new additions but from previously placed pieces as well. Complete your Puerh networks to secure end-game points. Deeper Strategy, Greater Rewards The Puerh expansion significantly increases the depth and complexity of Tea Garden, offering seasoned players richer decisions and expanded long-term planning. With the added strategic layers comes a slightly longer playtime—perfect for those who crave a more immersive experience. Includes Solo Play The expansion also features dedicated components for Solo play, allowing you to explore its strategic depth even on your own.

  • TRANSFORM YOUR TEA MASTER JOURNEY: Elevate your Tea Garden experience with the introduction of the Court of Nobles and dynamic Imperial Decrees, adding layers of tactical depth to every decision you make in the valley.
  • PREMIUM COURTIER MEEPLE SET: Features specialized Courtier figures to deploy in the grand halls, allowing you to compete for influence and earn valuable victory points through area majority at the end of each round.
  • STRATEGIC MARKET NETWORKING: Build intricate Puerh Market combinations to unlock immediate and recurring bonuses, connecting pieces to secure powerful end-game points and dominate the regional trade.
  • PERFECT FOR DEEP STRATEGY NIGHTS and intensive weekend hobby marathons—this expansion provides the immersive complexity and rewarding long-term planning that seasoned players desire during cozy winter evenings.
  • FOR VETERAN TEA CULTIVATORS: A must-have for fans of the original Tea Garden; suitable for home game rooms or local gaming clubs for those seeking a more rewarding and extended strategic challenge.

title: Star Wars: The Deckbuilding Game - Rebel & Empire Reinforcements Expansion
body:
The battle between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance continues in this new expansion to Star Wars™: The Deckbuilding Game’s original edition! Complete missions to add iconic units and ships to your deck, such as Yoda, Emperor Palpatine, R2-D2, Admiral Thrawn, and more. Try them out alongside three new game mods, including a five-part campaign mode where each game impacts the next!

Not a standalone expansion. A copy of the Star Wars: The Deckbuilding Game original edition (SWG01en) is required to play.

  • A new expansion for the original edition of Star Wars: The Deckbuilding Game, featuring upgrades and additional content to seamlessly integrate with your game..
  • Adds several iconic characters and ships to the game, such as R2-D2, Yoda, and the Taintive IV for the Rebels and Emperor Palpatine, Admiral Thrawn, and the Executor for the Imperials. 
  • Both the Rebel and the Imperial factions each gain 25 new reinforcement cards—powerful units that can only be earned through completing their corresponding in-game missions.
  • Three new modes offer new ways to play, including a campaign mode that transforms the game into a five-part series where each game impacts the next.

title: Marvel: Crisis Protocol - Guardians of the Galaxy Starter Set
body:
Occasionally being respected as a police force, but more often being maligned as undisciplined mercenaries, the Guardians of the Galaxy have been the heroes of the cosmos just a few times less than they've been the bane of it. However, there may be no better ragtag team of miscreants than the Guardians of the Galaxy. 

This starter contains the following Guardian of the Galaxy affiliation characters: Star-Lord, Gamora, Nebula, Rocket Raccoon, Groot, Drax, Ronan the Accuser, Cosmic Ghost Rider, Yondu, Nova.

The Marvel: Crisis Protocol Guardians of the Galaxy Starter includes a full roster of characters for the Guardians of the Galaxy affiliation. This pack gives one player everything they need to play a game of Marvel: Crisis Protocol and includes all the tokens, measuring tools, cards, and dice needed to play.

  • COMPLETE STARTER SET: Everything one player needs to play Marvel: Crisis Protocol, including miniatures, dice, cards, tokens, and measuring tools.
  • ICONIC GUARDIANS TEAM: Play as Star-Lord, Gamora, Groot, Rocket Raccoon, Drax, Nebula, Yondu, Nova, Ronan the Accuser, and Cosmic Ghost Rider.
  • 10 DETAILED MINIATURES: Includes highly detailed character miniatures with bases, perfect for immersive gameplay, collecting, and hobby painting.
  • FULL GAMEPLAY COMPONENTS: Comes with stat cards, team tactic cards, crisis cards, dice, movement tools, range rulers, and mission tracker.
  • PERFECT ENTRY POINT: Ideal for new players and fans of Marvel tabletop games, offering a complete experience with high replayability and strategic depth.

Contents:

10 Miniatures, 10 Bases, 10 Character Stat Cards, 15 Team Tactic Cards, 1 Infinity Gem Card, 12 Crisis Cards, 1 Punch Sheet, 1 Insert, 10 Dice, 1 Mission Tracker, 3 Tracking Cubes, 3 Movement Tools, 4 Range Tools

title: Marvel Champions: The Card Game - Fear No Evil Expansion
body:
When a surge in crime erupts across New York City, it’s the citizens who are threatened the most. Backed by a powerful ringleader, this new organized crime wave needs practiced hands and familiarity with the streets of New York in order to truly stand against it. The people need more than just heroes; they need a team of fearless Defenders.

It’s the beginning of a brand-new wave for Marvel Champions: The Card Game! As the game’s ninth campaign expansion, Fear No Evil brings a plethora of classic Defenders characters to the table, including two new playable heroes, Echo and the long-awaited Daredevil. Each of these heroes comes with a pre-built deck that is ready to play from the get-go. Standing opposed to the Defenders are Kingpin and five of his greatest underlings, all of whom are wreaking havoc in their latest crime spree. This expansion includes six brand-new scenarios, five of which can mix and match which villain is paired with them. Each scenario can be played individually or sequentially as part of a larger, evolving campaign. 

Whether you’re a longtime fan of the game or are just starting to build your collection, you won’t want to miss out on Fear No Evil!

Not a standalone expansion. A Marvel Champions: The Card Game core set is required to play.

  • The ninth campaign expansion for Marvel Champions: The Card Game, featuring Defenders-themed heroes and villains.
  • Two new heroes, Daredevil and Echo, leap into action with fully pre-built and ready-to-play decks.
  • Six new scenarios challenge players to dismantle New York’s criminal empire, pitting them against dangerous foes like Bullseye, Electro, Purple Man, and the notorious Kingpin himself.
  • Players can experience a thrilling, evolving campaign in which they face off against Kingpin’s underlings in an interchangeable order, slowly building up to a final confrontation against the crime lord himself.

title: Final Fantasy TCG Blissful Eternity Booster Pack
body:
Blissful Eternity”, the newly announced FFTCG booster pack releasing on July 31, 2026, features Tidus, the protagonist of FINAL FANTASY X which is celebrating its 25th anniversary on July 19, 2026. It’s one “Blissful” pack that’s loaded with numerous new cards bound to improve your deck alongside captivating you with amazing new art, beginning with Tidus.

This pack also marks the integration of “Noir” cards, which showcase select accent colors layered against a monochromatic base. “Noir” cards are designed using full art, and—while they’re not foil-stamped—they also feature printed signatures. For example, a stunning “Noir” Cloud [11-127L] can be found within this very pack!

(Please note that starting with this release, Crystal cards that previously came with standard sets will no longer be included.)

One (1) Premium Card included per pack

body: Defend Gotham City one puzzle at a time with the Batman 4-Pack 100-Piece Puzzles! This officially licensed set includes four dynamic scenes of Batman in action, saving the day and night. title: Greatest Hits - 2000's Artists 1000 Piece Puzzle
body: Step back into the unforgettable era of flip phones, MySpace, and chart-topping pop hits with this vibrant 1000-piece puzzle celebrating the greatest artists of the 2000s. Bursting with iconic album covers, unforgettable fashion trends, and unforgettable faces like Lady Gaga, Eminem, Beyoncé, and Green Day, this collage is a nostalgic tribute to the music that defined a generation. Every piece takes you closer to reliving the golden age of mixtapes, dance anthems, and late-night music videos. Perfect for music lovers and puzzle fans alike, this colorful throwback is more than just a challenge—it’s a time capsule of the decade that gave us pop-punk angst, R&B power ballads, and the rise of digital music culture. Whether you were blasting these hits in your car or downloading them onto your first MP3 player, this puzzle captures the heartbeat of the 2000s in one epic visual remix.

title: America's Navy - Blue Angels in Unison 1000 Piece Puzzle
body: Experience the thrill of high-speed precision and aerial mastery with this striking 1000-piece puzzle featuring the legendary U.S. Navy Blue Angels. Against a vivid blue sky, the iconic F/A-18 Hornets soar in perfect formation, their sleek lines and vibrant blue-and-gold paint scheme capturing the excitement of these world-famous flight demonstrations. The detailed artwork highlights the power, grace, and teamwork that make the Blue Angels a symbol of excellence in aviation. This challenging puzzle is perfect for aviation enthusiasts, military history buffs, and anyone who appreciates breathtaking artistry. As you connect each piece, you’ll relive the excitement of airshow performances, from sharp turns and synchronized maneuvers to dramatic sky-high climbs. Once complete, the finished image makes a bold display piece—a tribute to skill, dedication, and the awe-inspiring beauty of flight.

title: Alto
body:
Level up your discs to score more points – but don’t get too comfortable. The tiles guide your discs… but beware: once used, they flip and change direction. Use them a second time, and they’re removed from the game – potentially disrupting your entire strategy. Who will outsmart the shifting board and find their way to victory? Each tile offers different ways to move your disc. Aim higher – the better the level, the more points you score. Beware: Each tile can only be used twice. After that, it disappears. Don’t get stuck! Score 1 point for the first level, 2 points for the second, and so on. The player with the highest score wins.

Contents:

  • 16x double-sided tiles
  • 18x wooden discs
  • 1x rules booklet

title: Game Castle Tube Holder - White
body:
Transport your Playmat in style! Bring everything you need to your game night with the Game Castle TUBE HOLDER!

This nifty add-on lets players transport up to two Playmat Tubes with their Game Castle. It can be easily attached or detached to either side, allowing for full flexibility. The Tube Holder comes already including one Gamegenic Playmat Tube: the black version with a black tube, the white version with a clear tube. It is fully compatible with the Game Castle shoulder strap, providing comfort during transportation. Made from extra sturdy material, this add-on will safely hold and protect Playmat Tubes, even on the go!

Bringing extra playmats? Every Playmat Tube can hold up to 2 standard size playmats. Use 2 Tube Holders and bring a total of 4 Playmats in your Game Castle!

  • TRANSPORT YOUR PLAYMATS IN STYLE: The Game Castle Tube Holder is the perfect add-on for carrying your playmats to tournaments, game nights, or conventions—built for protection, style, and flexibility.
  • COMPLETE SET INCLUDED: Comes with one premium Gamegenic Playmat Tube (black version includes black tube). Each tube safely holds up to two standard-size playmats for convenient transport.
  • EASY ATTACH & DETACH DESIGN: Securely connects to either side of your Game Castle and can be removed or reattached effortlessly, allowing complete customization and comfort.
  • PERFECT FOR GAMERS ON THE GO: Fully compatible with the Game Castle shoulder strap for hands-free carrying. The durable, reinforced materials ensure your playmats stay protected, even during travel.
  • FOR TCG PLAYERS, CARD GAMERS & COLLECTORS: Ideal for fans of Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon, Lorcana, Flesh and Blood, and other trading card games who need safe, stylish playmat transport.

Contents:

One playmat tube with Game Castle-compatible attachment

title: Game Castle Black/White/Clear
body:
Take your gaming storage to the next level! The Game Castle is an ingenious, double-sided, all-in-one solution for board gamers, card game players, and tabletop fans. This brand-new product can be opened on either side to allow separate access to a large number of cards and tokens. The innovative design provides safe storage while also enabling easy and comfortable transportation to game nights or tournaments with the detachable, adjustable shoulder strap and integrated handle.

The Game Castle is a perfect storage solution for 6 Commander Decks (6x 100 double-sleeved cards), tokens, dice, movement/range tools, and many other gaming accessories! One side of the box houses six removable card holders for 600 double-sleeved cards in Thick Inner Sleeves or 800 board-game-sleeved cards. The other side holds 19 removable trays in 5 different sizes, including an extra-long tray to store movement/range tools, two trays in Mini-American card size, and two in Standard card game size. The trays can be swapped with those from the Gamegenic Token Silo family, offering many different size and color combinations. The innovative clip mechanism ensures a precise and secure closure.

The Game Castle is the definitive choice for gamers who value both safety and flexibility. Don't settle for less and join on the future of accessories!

  • ALL-IN-ONE SOLUTION: Features a double-sided case with separate access for cards and gaming accessories, enhancing organization and protection for your tabletop and card game components.
  • HIGH CAPACITY & MODULAR: Accommodates 6 Commander decks or up to 800 board-game-sleeved cards, alongside 19 removable trays in various sizes for dice, tokens, and tools.
  • INNOVATIVE DESIGN: Equipped with a robust clip mechanism for secure closure, and a modular tray system that’s compatible with Gamegenic's Token Silo products, allowing customizable storage solutions.
  • BUILT FOR DURABILITY: Constructed from shock-resistant materials with an integrated, reinforced handle, making it ideal for safe transport to game nights and tournaments.
  • VERSATILE & USER-FRIENDLY: Opens from both sides for easy access during gameplay, featuring trays that support everything from small tokens to large gaming tools, all in a compact design that’s easy to carry.

Contents:

One double-sided card storage case with 6 removable card holders and 19 removable accessory trays and one shoulder strap

title: Marvel: Crisis Protocol - Asgardians Starter Set
body:
The warriors of Asgard are many things: gods, mortals, guardians, and destroyers. Some fight with honor, others with cunning. All are bound by fate and legend. As ancient threats rise and the realms tremble, these powerful warriors must take up arms to defend what remains or seize power for themselves.

Joining forces under the banner of Asgard, this Starter Set brings together a legendary cast of fan-favorite characters. Thor, Loki, Valkyrie, Lady Sif, Heimdall, the Warriors Three, Mighty Thor, Angela, Skurge, and Enchantress stand ready to unleash the strength, sorcery, and splendor of the Realms on any who dare oppose them.

The Marvel: Crisis Protocol Asgardian Starter Set includes a full Roster of iconic characters from across the mythic realm of Asgard and includes all the tokens, Measuring Tools, cards, and dice needed to play.

  • COMPLETE STARTER SET: Everything one player needs to play Marvel: Crisis Protocol, including miniatures, dice, cards, tokens, and measuring tools.
  • LEGENDARY ASGARDIAN HEROES: Assemble Thor, Loki, Valkyrie, Lady Sif, Heimdall, Mighty Thor, Angela, Enchantress, Skurge, and the Warriors Three.
  • 10 DETAILED MINIATURES: Features highly detailed character miniatures with bases, ideal for immersive gameplay, collecting, and hobby painting.
  • FULL GAMEPLAY COMPONENTS: Includes character stat cards, team tactic cards, crisis cards, dice, movement tools, range rulers, and mission tracker.
  • PERFECT ENTRY POINT: Great for new players and Marvel fans, offering a complete experience with deep strategy and high replayability.

Contents:

10 Miniatures, 12 Bases, 10 Character Stat Cards, 20 Team Tactic Cards, 12 Crisis Cards, 1 Punch Sheet, 10 Dice, 1 Mission Tracker, 3 Tracking Cubes, 3 Movement Tools, 4 Range Tools, 1 Insert

title: Bluey Go Fish Card Game
body:
Bring the laughter of Bluey to your next playtime with the Bluey Go Fish Card Game! This fun and creative kids' game features two ways to play: Bluey Go Fish and Guess Bluey. Twice the family fun in one box! With 53 colorful picture cards inspired by Bluey’s world, there’s endless room for excitement! Perfect for ages 4 and up, this preschool game and family game is quick to learn, easy to play, and full of giggles. Whether it’s 2 people playing or the whole family, each session sparks imagination and connection. Great for family game nights, playdates, or anytime kids want to jump into Bluey’s world of play.

  • 2-IN-1 FAMILY FUN: Double the excitement with two unique ways to play! Enjoy a classic game of Bluey Go Fish to collect matching pairs of your favorite characters, or switch to Guess Bluey, a creative game where you act and ask questions to guess the character.
  • 53 VIBRANT CHARACTER CARDS: This set features 53 high-quality picture cards inspired by Bluey’s world. Each card is packed with color and familiar faces, helping children stay engaged while they develop visual recognition and storytelling skills.
  • EDUCATIONAL & SCREEN-FREE: Promote healthy development through laughter and play. This game helps preschoolers build essential early skills, including matching, memory, number recognition, and social confidence, all while enjoying screen-free interaction.
  • PERFECT FOR AGES 4 AND UP: With simple rules that are quick to learn and easy to play, this game is perfect for 2 or more players. It’s an ideal choice for family game nights, playdates, or any time kids want to jump into the clever adventures of Bluey and Bingo.

Contents:

53 x Cards, 1 x Instructions

title: Bluey The Creek Pop Game
body:
Bluey is a loveable, six-year-old Blue Heeler dog, who loves to turn everyday family life into endless, playful adventures. She loves to create and play unique games with her family and friends and now your child can join Bluey and her family in The Creek Pop Around Game. Hop over the creek in this dice -popping, rock hopping racing game! Make it all around the board and be the first player back home to win. 

This great plastic board game has a colorful background featuring Bluey, Bingo, Bandit and Chilli. Players need to get their 4 moving pieces around the board using the fun bubble-popper to roll the die. This classic Pop-'n'-Race board game includes 16 Player Pieces. An exciting and fun game for 2-4 players. Children age 3+ will love the popping action of the dice roller as they learn about number counting and taking turns as they race around the creek!

  • Join Bluey and her family in a fun, dice-popping racing game.
  • Hop over the creek and be the first player back home to win.
  • Use the fun bubble-popper to roll the die and move your pieces.
  • Features Bluey, Bingo, Bandit, and Chilli on a vibrant plastic board.
  • Perfect for 2-4 players aged 3+, teaching counting and turn-taking.

Contents:

1 game board, 16 colored pieces, 1 rule sheet

body:
Join Bluey, Bingo, Bandit and Chilli on a fun-filled supermarket adventure in the Bluey Shopping List Game! From sweet lollipops and crunchy corn chips to fragrant flowers and jars of peanut butter, it’s a race to see who can fill their trolley first—no time to dilly-dally! Perfect for kids aged 3 and up, this exciting memory and matching game helps build key skills like turn-taking, matching, and memory, all while delivering loads of laughter and fun. 

With bright, sturdy pieces and everyone’s favorite Bluey characters, it’s the ultimate game for little shoppers, big imaginations, and devoted Bluey fans. Whether it’s for family fun, preschool play, or a playful gift, the Bluey Shopping List Game is sure to delight every time you open the box! Ideal for 2-4 players.

title: Bluey Hide N Seek
body:
Now your little ones can bring home the fun and imaginative play of Bluey with the Bluey Hide & Seek Game! Kids can really play Hide and Seek with Bluey in their house with this adorable, interactive, electronic figure. Hide Bluey anywhere and press her nose to start the built-in timer. Bluey talks and giggles every few seconds to help lead you in the right direction to find her. Will your child and their friends find her before the timer runs out? The first person to find Bluey within the time wins! 

When the player finds Bluey, they can press her nose again to go into "Dance Mode" so everyone can dance to the Bluey theme-song. The cute electronic Bluey figure is articulated and stands at 15 cm / 6 inches tall. Every Bluey fan will love playing this exciting version of Hide and Seek. Makes a great party game or fun game with family and friends for 2 or more players, ages 3+.

  • Interactive Play: Kids can enjoy a real-life game of Hide and Seek with Bluey, a cute electronic figure that adds excitement to the classic game.
  • Built-in Timer and Sound Cues: Bluey talks and giggles periodically, helping players find her before the timer runs out.
  • Dance Mode: Once found, Bluey can enter "Dance Mode," where players can dance along to the Bluey theme song.
  • Articulated Electronic Figure: Bluey figure is 15 cm (6 inches) tall and movable, perfect for imaginative play.
  • Perfect for Parties and Playdates: Great for 2 or more players, ages 3 and up.

Contents:

1 Electronic Bluey Figure, 2 Try-Me AAA Batteries, 1 Instruction Manual

title: Bluey Grannies Game
body:

Inspired by the beloved “Grannies” episode, players collect silly items like glasses and walking sticks along their garden path to be the first to start a flossing party! 

With bright, sturdy pieces designed for little hands, this playful board game encourages social interaction, turn-taking, imaginative play, and supports fine motor skill development. Perfect for 2 to 4 players, the Bluey Grannies Game brings heaps of laughter, movement, and Bluey magic to family game night or any fun-filled playdate!

  • Fun And Interactive: Race to call Nana and find out if grannies can floss!
  • Collect & Race: Players aged 3+ collect items on their board like glasses and walking sticks to be the first to call Nana and start a flossing party.
  • Based On The Grannies Episode: Brings the laughter of the beloved ‘Grannies’ episode to life, featuring Bluey, Bingo, and their hilarious granny characters.
  • Teach Through Play: Encourages social interaction, turn-taking, and imaginative play while supporting the development of fine motor skills.
  • Ensure hours of giggles and family fun.

1 playing board, 1 sandpit board, 1 rules sheet, 4 playing pieces, 1 grannies scene, 12 item tiles

Designed for children aged 3+, this charming game supports memory and matching skills, turn-taking, and creativity. Perfect for 2 to 4 players, it’s a heartwarming blend of learning and laughter that’s ideal for family fun and little Bluey fans everywhere! So Romance!

  • For 2-4 Players, Aged 3+: Perfect for family fun, preschool play, and fans of Bluey!

title: Hidden Pathways Secret Lair Ultimate Edition
body:
Secret Lair's WPN-exclusive Ultimate Edition series is back with Secret Lair: Ultimate Edition 2!

Ultimate Edition 2 will be available May 7 at WPN stores around the world. This boxed set features ten full-art Pathway lands in premium foil with brand-new art from ten of Magic's best artists (Paul Scott Canavan, Alayna Danner, Piotr Dura, Grady Frederick, Donato Giancola, Yeong-Hao Han, Adam Paquette, Lucas Staniec, Jokubas Uogintas, and Johannes Voss) depicting the Planes of Kaldheim and Zendikar.

In Ultimate Edition 2, the six Pathway lands originally printed in Zendikar Rising are feature art showcasing the Plane of Kaldheim, and the four Pathway lands coming in Kaldheim feature art showcasing the Plane of Zendikar instead.

This means across all printings of these cards, you'll be able to nab complete cycles set on either Planeor both!

title: Riftbound League of Legends: Vendetta - Booster Pack
body:
Vendetta, the fourth set of Riftbound: League of Legends TCG, brings even more Champions to the battlefield! These 14-card booster packs pull from a pool of over 160 cards, with more than 50 Showcase cards! • Designed for Battle — Whether in 1v1 showdowns or shifting multiplayer alliances, Riftbound is built for a variety of exciting game formats!

body: The maneuverable saber-toothed tiger stalks its prey on silent paws. With its brown-pied coat, it is well camouflaged in the tall grass of the primeval savannah. Only the gentle waving of the grasses could betray its arrival. Once it has reached its target, the big cat suddenly lunges out of cover and opens its mouth with a dangerous snarl. With a quick leap, it pounces on its prey. Save yourself who can!

title: K-Pop Demon Hunters: The Official Deluxe Coloring Book
body:
Return to the vibrant world of KPop Demon Hunters with this official coloring book!

From hunters to demons to the fans they fight for—there’s a coloring page for everyone in this official KPop Demon Hunters coloring book! Style HUNTR/X for a savage demonic takedown with Rumi’s iconic yellow motorcycle jacket, Zoey’s teal top, and Mira’s magenta pigtails. Pull out baby blues and pastel pinks for Saja Boys’ bubbly debut of “Soda Pop,” and your richest reds and blacks for their riveting performance of “Your Idol.” Use some golden metallics to finally seal the Honmoon. Or color things your way to bring your own imagination to the hit animated film!

With 40 single-sided illustrations on thick, perforated paper and all the intricate details adult coloring fans crave, this coloring book is the perfect opportunity to spend more time with favorite characters and scenes from Netflix’s KPop Demon Hunters.

title: Warhammer 40K: Introductory Set (2026 Refresh)
body:
In the far future, Humanity wages a desperate war for survival. Hordes of brutal Orks assail its worlds. Standing against them are the Space Marines, genetically enhanced soldiers clad in sophisticated power armour.

Warhammer 40,000 is a game of thrilling tabletop battles, in which you take control of armies of detailed miniatures. Dive into the galaxy of Warhammer 40,000 with this introductory set. The box contains everything you need to begin exploring this diverse and exciting hobby. There are paints and gaming accessories to get you started, and detailed guides show you how to assemble and paint your models in a series of easy-to-follow steps. The guide also includes a narrative section, detailing the transhuman Space Marines and the savage alien Orks, plus introductory rules allowing you to pit your models against each other in exciting battles.

This box includes 12 multipart plastic push-fit miniatures:
– 1 Lieutenant
– 5 Intercessors
– 1 Ork Nob
– 5 Ork Boyz

The Space Marines are cast in blue plastic, and the Orks are cast in green plastic. The miniatures in this set are each supplied with a sculpted base.

This set contains the following accessories and Warhammer Colour paint pots:
– 1 softcover 48-page handbook
– 1 double-sided playing mat
– 3 sheets of punch-out card terrain
– 1 Warhammer Colour Starter Brush
– 1 transparent plastic range ruler
– 6 white D6 dice with black pips
– 1 Abaddon Black (Base)
– 1 Macragge Blue (Base)
– 1 Mournfang Brown (Base)
– 1 Leadbelcher (Base)
– 1 Retributor Armour (Base)
– 1 Orruk Flesh (Base)

The 6 paints are supplied in 12ml pots.

The kit comes supplied with:
– 94 plastic components

title: Warhammer 40,000 Starter Set (2026 Refresh)
body:
In the nightmare future of the 41st Millennium, Humanity teeters on the brink of destruction. Mankind’s alien enemies, the brutal Orks, battle against the valiant Space Marines. It is a desperate struggle that will decide the fate of entire star systems.

Warhammer 40,000 is a tabletop battle game in which you take command of the forces of the Imperium or their deadly foes. This set allows you to fight conflicts between the Space Marines and Orks. The two sides are represented by models – which you assemble and paint yourself – and the action unfolds around evocative battlefield terrain. This set contains everything you need to play Warhammer 40,000, including two Combat Patrols. Learn to play the game with easy-to-follow guides that introduce you to the rules as you play.

The Warhammer 40,000 Starter Set includes:

1 softcover Core Rules booklet
A convenient and portable 88-page rules booklet containing everything you need to play, including the basic rules of the game, the battle round, battlefield, and advanced rules, with a reference section. This book measures 160mm by 230mm.

1 softcover Starter Set Handbook
An 88-page guide to getting started in the Warhammer 40,000 hobby – including how to build, paint, and play games with your miniatures.

2 double-sided Reference Sheets
Including army rules, stratagems, enhancements and data sheets for Combat Patrol games.

46 multipart plastic push-fit miniatures
Comprising 2 complete Combat Patrol armies, which can be assembled without glue. Both forces include a mix of infantry, leaders, and support, forming a solid core to expand your collections or start new ones.

13 Space Marines
Elite, genetically enhanced soldiers with the finest armour, weapons, and wargear available. They will stop at nothing to protect the Imperium.
– 1 Captain with Relic Shield

title: Longshot (HB) (OOS)
body:
An Astra Militarum Novel

A celebrated sniper of the Astra Militarum must shift her focus to commanding troops, and dealing with the complications that arise from hard decisions.

READ IT BECAUSE
It's a look into the haunted thoughts of a soldier wrestling with the complex realities of a galaxy at war. Every choice she makes has consequences for those under her command.

THE STORY
Transplant. Cadian. Sniper. Legend.

Sergeant Darya Nevic is all of these and more… but behind the stories stands a soldier haunted by the unwelcome fame her successes have brought.

During the Cadian 217th’s assault on the manufactorum world of Attruso, Darya finds herself out of her depth, in a war that is fought with words as much as with weapons. As a fearsome winter closes in and her men begin to die around her, she will be forced to confront her doubts and make an impossible choice – to become the figurehead her soldiers need, or to believe the unimaginable promises of the mysterious T’au.

With the fate of her regiment in her hands, which path will she choose?

Written by Rob Young.

title: Ghosts of Cadia (HB) (OOS)
body:
An Astra Militarum Novel

A sniper and sergeant leads her squad behind enemy lines in an apparent suicide mission. The fate of an entire world rests in her hands.

READ IT BECAUSE
It's another perspective on the remnants of Cadia, as they carry their war to every corner of the galaxy. This story focuses on the 217th, and their war to liberate a world from heretics, against all odds.

THE STORY
Darya Nevic is a sniper and a hardened survivor, but endless loss has pushed her to breaking point. As the Cadian 217th war to liberate the world of Parrescum from heretic forces grows ever more deadly, the sergeant fights to keep her squad alive as she is hounded by the memories of those she failed to save. In the wake of disaster, a chance encounter offers Darya a way to not only strike back at the heretics, but to settle a debt she thought impossible to repay. She must lead a mission deep behind enemy lines, where death is all but certain. Yet there is even more at risk than she knows. The Parrescum lies in Darya's hands, and unless she can escape the ghosts of her past, the planet will fall.

Written by Rob Young.

title: 2025/26 Panini Select Road to FIFA World Cup Soccer Hobby Box
body:
Each Box contains 3 Autographs/Memorabilia Cards, 7 Inserts/Parallels, 5 Numbered Base Parallels, and 9 Other Base Parallels, on average!

Be on the look out for 4 different super-rare, limited inserts: Stained Glass, Artistic Impressions, Visionary and Team Badges. Find one of each per case, on average.

Open 3 Autograph and/or Memorabilia cards per hobby box, on average, including signers Kylian Mbappe, Lionel Messi, Erling Haaland, Neymar Jr. and many more.

title: 2025/26 Panini Obsidian Soccer Hobby Box
body:
Each Box contains 4 Autographs or Memorabilia Cards, 1 Parallel, 1 Insert or Insert Parallel, and 1 Base Card, on average!

2025-26 marks the seventh consecutive season for Obsidian Soccer, with its stylish black opti-chrome.

The program features a wide selection of club teams, such as Liverpool FC, Bayer 04 Leverkusen, Real Madrid, FC Internazionale Milano and more.

Obsidian's striking dark aesthetic is boldly accentuated by a stunning wave of Electric Etch parallels that permeate the entire set.

Black Color Blast cards and Contra parallels are both found one per Hobby case. Rare color-Flood parallels in the set are sure to be a hit.

Some of the greatest legends and biggest superstars in soccer history are profiled in Obsidian's spectacular lineup of autograph and memorabilia cards.

Also, look for the new Hobby-exclusive Caldera parallel, numbered to 25!

Configuration: 7 Cards Per Box

title: 2025/26 Panini Court Kings Basketball Hobby Box
body:
Each Box contains 2 Autographs or Memorabilia Cards, 3 Base/Base Parallels, 2 Inserts/Insert Parallels, 1 Rookie II, II, IV, or 0, and 2 Rookies I, on average!

Court Kings returns for the 2025-26 season offering some unique and art-based designs!

Look for Autographs from new sets including Rookie Jersey Autographs, Portrait Signatures, Legacy Portrait Signatures, Canvas Autographs, Next Day Autographs, and Next Day Dual Autographs which feature on-card autographs of the 2025-26 Rookie Class!

Collect all four versions of the rookies in Rookies I, Rookies II, Rookies III, and Rookies IV! Also search for the super-short printed Rookies 0! Also search for new inserts in Studio and Artistry in Motion!

Chase after super short-printed inserts such as Aurora, Paint by Number, State of the Art, and Le Cinque Piu Belle! Collectors should also be on the look out for the new SSP inserts King of the Court as well as the popular Blank Slate!

Unpack Memorabilia cards such as Debut Showcase Memorabilia, Art Noveau, and Artistic Endeavors!

title: Berserk Vol. 23
body:
Desperate as Guts, the Black Swordsman, has been to reunite with his former captain and lover, the now-mad Casca, he’s quickly learning that being together is as dangerous as being apart. What should be a simple journey to the safety of Puck’s homeland proves to be a gauntlet of perils, as the Mark of Sacrifice each bears brings the fury of Hell down upon them, and Guts discovers that in his darkest moments he himself is the greatest danger to the woman he loves.

Created by Kentaro Miura, Berserk is a fiery manga apocalypse, an ominous omnibus of furious action, fearsome horror, and funereal humor that strikes a power chord in the hearts of its devoted followers and strikes down the rest like a scythe through wheat. Bring in the sheaves!

title: Cynthia's Garchomp ex Premium Collection
body:
Cynthia & Garchomp Bring the Strength of a Champion!
As Champion of the Sinnoh region, Cynthia is one of the strongest Pokemon Trainers in the world, and her Garchomp has been by her side since the very beginning! Discover the power of their friendship in this collection with a foil promo card featuring Cynthia's Garchomp ex, which has attacks that do big damage and help you draw cards. You also get foil cards of Cynthia's Gible and Cynthia's Gabite, a cool sticker and standees for display, and more Pokemon inside booster packs.

The Pokemon TCG: Cynthia's Garchomp ex Premium Collection includes:
• 1 full-art foil promo card featuring Cynthia's Garchomp ex
• 2 foil cards featuring Cynthia's Gible and Cynthia's Gabite
• 1 sheet of acrylic standees featuring Cynthia, Garchomp, and more
• 1 double-sided backdrop display
• 1 photo sticker featuring Cynthia and Garchomp
• 6 Pokemon TCG booster packs
• A code card for Pokemon TCG Live
